unit.title: Progression P2 — Education and Future Plans
unit.summary: School systems, university, careers, study skills and reported speech.

lessons.title: School Systems and Academic Life
lessons.summary: Describe and compare education systems in academic register, using formal comparison and the academic verbs يَجْتَازُ، يَتَفَوَّقُ فِي and يَرْسُبُ فِي.
objectives: Name the stages of an education system in academic Arabic.
Use يَجْتَازُ، يَتَفَوَّقُ فِي، يَرْسُبُ فِي and يَلْتَحِقُ بِـ with correct complements.
Compare two systems with بَيْنَمَا، فِي حِينِ أَنَّ and يَتَمَيَّزُ بِـ.
Write a comparative description of two school systems.
success: I follow each academic verb with its fixed preposition.
I use a formal contrast connector rather than only وَ.
I keep non-human plural agreement feminine singular.
I compare systems rather than listing facts about each.

teach.title: Each academic verb keeps its own preposition
teach.text: يَجْتَازُ takes a direct object (يَجْتَازُ الامْتِحَانَ), while يَتَفَوَّقُ and يَرْسُبُ both take فِي (يَتَفَوَّقُ فِي الرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ، يَرْسُبُ فِي المَادَّةِ). يَلْتَحِقُ takes بِـ. Store each verb with its complement.

teach.title: Compare, do not just list
teach.text: A strong comparison sets systems against each other: يَتَمَيَّزُ النِّظَامُ البِرِيطَانِيُّ بِمَرَاحِلَ وَاضِحَةٍ، فِي حِينِ أَنَّ النِّظَامَ فِي بَعْضِ الدُّوَلِ يَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى الامْتِحَانِ النِّهَائِيِّ. That earns more than describing each system separately.

grammar.title: Academic verbs and formal comparison
grammar.overview: The education verbs with their fixed complements, and the connectors that build a formal comparison between two systems.

rules.heading: Exam verbs
rules.formula: يَجْتَازُ + object · يَرْسُبُ فِي · يَتَفَوَّقُ فِي
rules.explanation: One takes a direct object; the other two take فِي.
examples: يَتَفَوَّقُ فِي العُلُومِ وَيَرْسُبُ زَمِيلُهُ فِي المَادَّةِ نَفْسِهَا

rules.heading: Enrolment and attainment
rules.explanation: Enrolment takes بِـ; obtaining takes عَلَى.

rules.heading: Formal contrast
rules.formula: بَيْنَمَا · فِي حِينِ أَنَّ · فِي المُقَابِلِ
rules.explanation: Set one system against another instead of chaining وَ.
examples: بَيْنَمَا يَدُومُ التَّعْلِيمُ الثَّانَوِيُّ ثَلَاثَ سَنَوَاتٍ، يَمْتَدُّ فِي غَيْرِهَا أَكْثَرَ
فِي حِينِ أَنَّ النِّظَامَ الأَوَّلَ يَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى الامْتِحَانِ، يَعْتَمِدُ الثَّانِي عَلَى المَشَارِيعِ

rules.heading: Distinguishing feature
rules.explanation: Name what marks a system out.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate sentence with يَجْتَازُ.
quiz.feedback: يَجْتَازُ takes a direct object.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يَتَفَوَّقُ الطَّالِبُ ___ الرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ.
quiz.feedback: يَتَفَوَّقُ is fixed with فِي.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يَرْسُبُ بَعْضُ الطُّلَّابِ ___ المَادَّةِ الصَّعْبَةِ.
quiz.feedback: يَرْسُبُ is fixed with فِي.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يَلْتَحِقُ الطَّالِبُ ___ الجَامِعَةِ.
quiz.feedback: يَلْتَحِقُ is fixed with بِـ.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يَحْصُلُ ___ شَهَادَةٍ مُعْتَمَدَةٍ.
quiz.feedback: يَحْصُلُ is fixed with عَلَى.

quiz.prompt: Which is a formal contrast connector?
quiz.feedback: فِي حِينِ أَنَّ sets one system against another.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate distinguishing sentence.
quiz.feedback: يَتَمَيَّزُ is fixed with بِـ.

quiz.prompt: Which sentence compares rather than lists?
options: بَيْنَمَا يَعْتَمِدُ النِّظَامُ الأَوَّلُ عَلَى الامْتِحَانِ، يَعْتَمِدُ الثَّانِي عَلَى المَشَارِيعِ.
quiz.feedback: It sets the two systems against each other with بَيْنَمَا.

grammar.common_error: Adding فِي after يَجْتَازُ, or swapping the prepositions of يَلْتَحِقُ (بِـ) and يَحْصُلُ (عَلَى). Learn each verb with its complement.
grammar.challenge: Write one comparison with بَيْنَمَا and one distinguishing sentence with يَتَمَيَّزُ بِـ.

patterns.ar: يَجْتَازُ الطُّلَّابُ الامْتِحَانَ فِي سِنِّ السَّادِسَةَ عَشْرَةَ
patterns.label: What to notice

patterns.ar: يَتَفَوَّقُ فِي العُلُومِ وَيَلْتَحِقُ بِالجَامِعَةِ
patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: فِي with يَتَفَوَّقُ, بِـ with يَلْتَحِقُ.

patterns.ar: بَيْنَمَا يَعْتَمِدُ النِّظَامُ الأَوَّلُ عَلَى الامْتِحَانِ، يَعْتَمِدُ الثَّانِي عَلَى المَشَارِيعِ
patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: A formal comparison, not a list.

mistakes.why: يَجْتَازُ takes a direct object, not فِي.
يَلْتَحِقُ is fixed with بِـ.
يَتَمَيَّزُ is fixed with بِـ.

listening.title: Listening: two systems compared
listening.script: يَتَكَوَّنُ النِّظَامُ التَّعْلِيمِيُّ البِرِيطَانِيُّ مِنْ ثَلَاثِ مَرَاحِلَ: الاِبْتِدَائِيَّةِ وَالإِعْدَادِيَّةِ وَالثَّانَوِيَّةِ. يَجْتَازُ الطُّلَّابُ امْتِحَانَاتِ الشَّهَادَةِ فِي نِهَايَةِ الثَّانَوِيَّةِ، وَيَتَفَوَّقُ بَعْضُهُمْ فَيَحْصُلُونَ عَلَى أَعْلَى الدَّرَجَاتِ. بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ يَلْتَحِقُونَ بِالجَامِعَةِ أَوْ يَخْتَارُونَ التَّدْرِيبَ المِهَنِيَّ. فِي المُقَابِلِ، يَخْتَلِفُ النِّظَامُ فِي بَعْضِ الدُّوَلِ العَرَبِيَّةِ؛ فَبَيْنَمَا يَدُومُ التَّعْلِيمُ الثَّانَوِيُّ ثَلَاثَ سَنَوَاتٍ فِي بَلَدٍ، يَمْتَدُّ فِي غَيْرِهِ أَكْثَرَ. وَيَتَمَيَّزُ كُلُّ نِظَامٍ بِمَوَادَّ إِلْزَامِيَّةٍ وَأُخْرَى اِخْتِيَارِيَّةٍ. وَإِذَا أُتِيحَ لِلطُّلَّابِ وَقْتٌ لِلْإِبْدَاعِ، سَتَتَحَسَّنُ نَتَائِجُهُمْ.

questions.prompt: How many stages does the British system have?
questions.feedback: يَتَكَوَّنُ … مِنْ ثَلَاثِ مَرَاحِلَ.

questions.prompt: What do students do at the end of secondary school?
questions.feedback: يَجْتَازُ الطُّلَّابُ امْتِحَانَاتِ الشَّهَادَةِ فِي نِهَايَةِ الثَّانَوِيَّةِ.

questions.prompt: What do high achievers obtain?
questions.feedback: يَتَفَوَّقُ بَعْضُهُمْ فَيَحْصُلُونَ عَلَى أَعْلَى الدَّرَجَاتِ.

questions.prompt: How is the Arab-world system introduced?
options: It differs; secondary length varies by country
It is identical to the British
questions.feedback: يَخْتَلِفُ النِّظَامُ … بَيْنَمَا يَدُومُ … فِي بَلَدٍ، يَمْتَدُّ فِي غَيْرِهِ أَكْثَرَ.

questions.prompt: What would improve results, per the closing conditional?
questions.feedback: إِذَا أُتِيحَ لِلطُّلَّابِ وَقْتٌ لِلْإِبْدَاعِ، سَتَتَحَسَّنُ نَتَائِجُهُمْ.

reading.title: Reading: what makes a system work
reading.text: لَا تُقَاسُ جَوْدَةُ المَنْظُومَةِ التَّعْلِيمِيَّةِ بِعَدَدِ الامْتِحَانَاتِ فَقَطْ، بَلْ بِمَا يَتَعَلَّمُهُ الطَّالِبُ فِعْلًا. يَتَمَيَّزُ نِظَامٌ جَيِّدٌ بِتَوَازُنٍ بَيْنَ المَوَادِّ الإِلْزَامِيَّةِ وَالاِخْتِيَارِيَّةِ، وَبِنِظَامِ تَقْيِيمٍ عَادِلٍ. فَفِي بَعْضِ الدُّوَلِ يَجْتَازُ الطُّلَّابُ امْتِحَانًا نِهَائِيًّا وَاحِدًا، فِي حِينِ أَنَّ دُوَلًا أُخْرَى تَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى التَّقْيِيمِ المُسْتَمِرِّ. وَيَلْتَحِقُ المُتَفَوِّقُونَ بِالجَامِعَاتِ، بَيْنَمَا يَخْتَارُ آخَرُونَ التَّدْرِيبَ المِهَنِيَّ، وَكِلَا المَسَارَيْنِ مُحْتَرَمٌ. وَإِذَا رَكَّزَتِ المَنْظُومَةُ عَلَى التَّفْكِيرِ لَا الحِفْظِ، فَسَيَزْدَادُ إِبْدَاعُ الطُّلَّابِ. وَلَيْسَ هُنَاكَ نِظَامٌ مِثَالِيٌّ، لٰكِنَّ المُرُونَةَ تَقْتَرِبُ بِهِ مِنَ الأَفْضَلِ.

questions.prompt: How is a system's quality measured, per the text?
options: By what the student actually learns
By the number of exams only
By the size of the school
questions.feedback: بَلْ بِمَا يَتَعَلَّمُهُ الطَّالِبُ فِعْلًا.

questions.prompt: What distinguishes a good system?
options: Balance of subjects and fair assessment
questions.feedback: يَتَمَيَّزُ نِظَامٌ جَيِّدٌ بِتَوَازُنٍ … وَبِنِظَامِ تَقْيِيمٍ عَادِلٍ.

questions.prompt: How do some countries assess, in contrast?
options: Continuous assessment instead of one final exam
questions.feedback: فِي حِينِ أَنَّ دُوَلًا أُخْرَى تَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى التَّقْيِيمِ المُسْتَمِرِّ.

questions.prompt: What does the text say about vocational training?
options: It is a respected path alongside university
questions.feedback: وَكِلَا المَسَارَيْنِ مُحْتَرَمٌ.

questions.prompt: What follows from focusing on thinking over memorising?
questions.feedback: إِذَا رَكَّزَتِ المَنْظُومَةُ عَلَى التَّفْكِيرِ لَا الحِفْظِ، فَسَيَزْدَادُ إِبْدَاعُ الطُّلَّابِ.

prompts: صِفْ مَرَاحِلَ نِظَامِكَ التَّعْلِيمِيِّ.
قَارِنْ بَيْنَ نِظَامَيْنِ مُسْتَعْمِلًا بَيْنَمَا أَوْ فِي حِينِ أَنَّ.
بِمَاذَا يَتَمَيَّزُ نِظَامُكَ المِثَالِيُّ؟
model: يَتَكَوَّنُ نِظَامُنَا مِنْ ثَلَاثِ مَرَاحِلَ، وَيَجْتَازُ الطُّلَّابُ امْتِحَانَاتِ الشَّهَادَةِ فِي نِهَايَةِ الثَّانَوِيَّةِ.
يَتَمَيَّزُ بِمُرُونَةِ المَوَادِّ الاِخْتِيَارِيَّةِ، وَإِذَا أُتِيحَ وَقْتٌ لِلْإِبْدَاعِ، سَتَتَحَسَّنُ النَّتَائِجُ.

writing.prompt: Write ninety to one hundred words comparing two education systems. Use يَجْتَازُ and يَتَفَوَّقُ فِي, at least two formal contrast connectors (بَيْنَمَا، فِي حِينِ أَنَّ), and close with a Type 1 conditional about what would improve a system.
checklist: The academic verbs with their correct complements.
Two formal contrast connectors, not chained وَ.
One يَتَمَيَّزُ بِـ describing a distinguishing feature.
A closing Type 1 conditional.
writing.model: يَتَكَوَّنُ النِّظَامُ التَّعْلِيمِيُّ البِرِيطَانِيُّ مِنْ ثَلَاثِ مَرَاحِلَ رَئِيسِيَّةٍ، وَيَجْتَازُ الطُّلَّابُ امْتِحَانَاتِ الشَّهَادَةِ فِي سِنِّ السَّادِسَةَ عَشْرَةَ، وَيَتَفَوَّقُ بَعْضُهُمْ فَيَلْتَحِقُونَ بِالجَامِعَاتِ. فِي المُقَابِلِ، يَخْتَلِفُ النِّظَامُ فِي بَعْضِ الدُّوَلِ العَرَبِيَّةِ؛ فَبَيْنَمَا يَدُومُ التَّعْلِيمُ الثَّانَوِيُّ ثَلَاثَ سَنَوَاتٍ فِي بَلَدٍ، يَمْتَدُّ فِي غَيْرِهِ أَكْثَرَ. وَيَتَمَيَّزُ كُلُّ نِظَامٍ بِتَوَازُنٍ بَيْنَ المَوَادِّ الإِلْزَامِيَّةِ وَالاِخْتِيَارِيَّةِ. فِي حِينِ أَنَّ نِظَامًا يَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى الامْتِحَانِ النِّهَائِيِّ، يَعْتَمِدُ آخَرُ عَلَى التَّقْيِيمِ المُسْتَمِرِّ. وَفِي رَأْيِي، إِذَا رَكَّزَتِ المَنْظُومَةُ عَلَى التَّفْكِيرِ لَا الحِفْظِ، فَسَيَتَحَسَّنُ التَّحْصِيلُ.

lessons.title: Reported Speech — What People Say About Education
lessons.arabic: الكَلَامُ المَنْقُولُ — مَا يَقُولُهُ النَّاسُ عَنِ التَّعْلِيمِ
lessons.summary: The P2 milestone: report what people say with قَالَ إِنَّ and other verbs, choosing إِنَّ or أَنَّ, replacing pronouns and handling tense.
objectives: Report speech with قَالَ إِنَّ، أَضَافَ أَنَّ، أَوْضَحَ أَنَّ and others.
Choose إِنَّ after قَالَ and أَنَّ after the other reporting verbs.
Replace a first-person pronoun with a third-person one.
Keep the reported tense correct: truth present, past past, future future.
success: I use إِنَّ only after قَالَ and أَنَّ after the rest.
I attach the right pronoun to إِنَّ / أَنَّ (إِنَّهُ، أَنَّهَا).
I keep a past statement past and a future one future.
I vary my reporting verbs across a report.

teach.title: قَالَ takes إِنَّ; the others take أَنَّ
teach.text: After قَالَ use إِنَّ: قَالَ إِنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ مُهِمٌّ — never قَالَ أَنَّ. Every other reporting verb takes أَنَّ: أَضَافَ أَنَّ، أَوْضَحَ أَنَّ، أَكَّدَ أَنَّ. Both make the following noun accusative (التَّعْلِيمَ).

teach.title: Swap the pronoun, keep the tense
teach.text: Direct «سَأَدْرُسُ الطِّبَّ» becomes قَالَ إِنَّهُ سَيَدْرُسُ الطِّبَّ: the first-person becomes a third-person pronoun (هُ), and the future stays future. A past statement stays past: «دَرَسْتُ» → قَالَ إِنَّهُ دَرَسَ.

grammar.title: Reporting speech in Arabic
grammar.overview: Choose a reporting verb, add إِنَّ or أَنَّ, swap the pronoun to third person, and keep the tense. Arabic reporting is simpler than English: no automatic tense back-shift.

rules.heading: إِنَّ vs أَنَّ
rules.explanation: إِنَّ only after قَالَ; أَنَّ after the other verbs.
examples: أَكَّدَ أَنَّ المَنَاهِجَ يَجِبُ أَنْ تَتَطَوَّرَ

rules.heading: Accusative after the particle
rules.explanation: The noun after إِنَّ / أَنَّ is accusative; the predicate stays nominative.

rules.heading: Pronoun replacement
rules.explanation: Attach the third-person pronoun to إِنَّ / أَنَّ.

rules.heading: Tense stays
rules.formula: truth present · past past · future future
rules.explanation: No back-shift: keep the original tense.
examples: أَشَارَ إِلَى أَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ الرَّقْمِيَّ يُوَفِّرُ فُرَصًا

quiz.prompt: Complete: أَضَافَ ___ المَنَاهِجَ تَتَطَوَّرُ.

quiz.prompt: Report «دَرَسْتُ بِجِدٍّ» said by a girl.
quiz.feedback: Past stays past; إِنَّ after قَالَ with the right pronoun.

quiz.prompt: Complete: أَشَارَ الخَبِيرُ ___ أَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ يَتَطَوَّرُ.
quiz.feedback: أَشَارَ is fixed with إِلَى before أَنَّ.

quiz.prompt: Which noun case is correct after أَنَّ?

quiz.feedback: اِعْتَرَفَ is fixed with بِـ before أَنَّ.

quiz.prompt: Which report varies its verbs and is accurate?
options: قَالَ إِنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ حَقٌّ، وَأَضَافَ أَنَّهُ يَتَطَوَّرُ.
قَالَ أَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ حَقٌّ وَقَالَ أَنَّهُ يَتَطَوَّرُ.
قَالَ إِنَّ التَّعْلِيمُ حَقٌّ وَأَضَافَ إِنَّهُ يَتَطَوَّرُ.
quiz.feedback: إِنَّ after قَالَ, أَنَّ after أَضَافَ, accusative noun, varied verbs.

grammar.common_error: Writing قَالَ أَنَّ. Only قَالَ takes إِنَّ; every other reporting verb takes أَنَّ. Also keep the noun after the particle accusative.
grammar.challenge: Report three short quotes using three different reporting verbs, one past and one future.

listening.title: Listening: reporting a research study
listening.script: أَجْرَتْ دِرَاسَةٌ حَدِيثَةٌ فِي جَامِعَةٍ عَرَبِيَّةٍ بَحْثًا حَوْلَ التَّعْلِيمِ الرَّقْمِيِّ. خَلَصَ البَاحِثُونَ إِلَى أَنَّ الطُّلَّابَ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَعْمِلُونَ التِّقْنِيَّةَ يَتَفَوَّقُونَ عَلَى أَقْرَانِهِمْ. وَأَوْضَحَ التَّقْرِيرُ أَنَّ التَّعَلُّمَ عَنْ بُعْدٍ يُوَفِّرُ فُرَصًا لَمْ تَكُنْ مُتَاحَةً سَابِقًا. وَأَشَارَ الخُبَرَاءُ إِلَى أَنَّ المَنَاهِجَ يَجِبُ أَنْ تَتَطَوَّرَ لِمُوَاكَبَةِ التَّحَدِّيَاتِ. لٰكِنَّ أَحَدَ البَاحِثِينَ اِعْتَرَفَ بِأَنَّ الفَجْوَةَ الرَّقْمِيَّةَ مَا زَالَتْ مُشْكِلَةً. وَقَالَ إِنَّ الحَلَّ يَبْدَأُ بِتَدْرِيبِ المُعَلِّمِينَ. وَفْقًا لِهٰذِهِ الدِّرَاسَةِ، التِّقْنِيَّةُ أَدَاةٌ، وَلَيْسَتْ بَدِيلًا عَنِ المُعَلِّمِ.

questions.prompt: What did the researchers conclude?
options: Students who use technology outperform their peers
questions.feedback: خَلَصَ البَاحِثُونَ إِلَى أَنَّ الطُّلَّابَ … يَتَفَوَّقُونَ عَلَى أَقْرَانِهِمْ.

questions.prompt: What did the report explain about distance learning?
questions.feedback: أَوْضَحَ التَّقْرِيرُ أَنَّ التَّعَلُّمَ عَنْ بُعْدٍ يُوَفِّرُ فُرَصًا لَمْ تَكُنْ مُتَاحَةً.

questions.prompt: What did the experts point out?
questions.feedback: أَشَارَ الخُبَرَاءُ إِلَى أَنَّ المَنَاهِجَ يَجِبُ أَنْ تَتَطَوَّرَ.

questions.prompt: What did one researcher admit?
options: The digital gap is still a problem
questions.feedback: اِعْتَرَفَ بِأَنَّ الفَجْوَةَ الرَّقْمِيَّةَ مَا زَالَتْ مُشْكِلَةً.

questions.prompt: What is technology, according to the study?
options: A tool, not a substitute for the teacher
questions.feedback: التِّقْنِيَّةُ أَدَاةٌ، وَلَيْسَتْ بَدِيلًا عَنِ المُعَلِّمِ.

reading.title: Reading: what the experts said
reading.text: فِي مُؤْتَمَرٍ عَنِ التَّعْلِيمِ، تَحَدَّثَ ثَلَاثَةُ خُبَرَاءَ. قَالَ الأَوَّلُ إِنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ الجَيِّدَ يَبْدَأُ بِالمُعَلِّمِ، وَأَضَافَ أَنَّ التِّقْنِيَّةَ وَحْدَهَا لَا تَكْفِي. أَمَّا الثَّانِيَةُ فَأَكَّدَتْ أَنَّ التَّعَلُّمَ عَنْ بُعْدٍ يُوَفِّرُ فُرَصًا لِمَنْ يَعِيشُونَ بَعِيدًا عَنِ المَدَارِسِ. وَأَشَارَتْ إِلَى أَنَّ الفَجْوَةَ الرَّقْمِيَّةَ تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى حَلٍّ. وَنَفَى الثَّالِثُ أَنَّ الامْتِحَانَاتِ وَحْدَهَا تَقِيسُ الذَّكَاءَ، وَذَكَرَ أَنَّ المَهَارَاتِ العَمَلِيَّةَ لَا تَقِلُّ أَهَمِّيَّةً. وَفْقًا لِلْخُبَرَاءِ الثَّلَاثَةِ، التَّعْلِيمُ الجَيِّدُ يُوَازِنُ بَيْنَ المُعَلِّمِ وَالتِّقْنِيَّةِ وَالمَهَارَةِ.

questions.prompt: What did the first expert say?
options: Good education begins with the teacher
questions.feedback: قَالَ الأَوَّلُ إِنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ الجَيِّدَ يَبْدَأُ بِالمُعَلِّمِ.

questions.prompt: What did the first expert add?
questions.feedback: وَأَضَافَ أَنَّ التِّقْنِيَّةَ وَحْدَهَا لَا تَكْفِي.

questions.prompt: What did the second expert stress about distance learning?
options: It provides opportunities for those far from schools
questions.feedback: أَكَّدَتْ أَنَّ التَّعَلُّمَ عَنْ بُعْدٍ يُوَفِّرُ فُرَصًا لِمَنْ يَعِيشُونَ بَعِيدًا.

questions.prompt: What did the third expert deny?
questions.feedback: وَنَفَى الثَّالِثُ أَنَّ الامْتِحَانَاتِ وَحْدَهَا تَقِيسُ الذَّكَاءَ.

questions.prompt: What is the shared conclusion?
options: Good education balances teacher, technology and skill
questions.feedback: التَّعْلِيمُ الجَيِّدُ يُوَازِنُ بَيْنَ المُعَلِّمِ وَالتِّقْنِيَّةِ وَالمَهَارَةِ.

prompts: اِسْمَعْ رَأْيَ زَمِيلِكَ ثُمَّ اِنْقُلْهُ بِـ«قَالَ إِنَّ».
أَضِفْ نُقْطَةً ثَانِيَةً بِـ«وَأَضَافَ أَنَّ».
اُذْكُرْ مَصْدَرًا بِـ«وَفْقًا لِـ».
model: مَا رَأْيُ زَمِيلِكَ فِي التَّعَلُّمِ عَنْ بُعْدٍ؟
قَالَ إِنَّهُ يُوَفِّرُ فُرَصًا كَثِيرَةً، وَأَضَافَ أَنَّهُ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى إِنْتِرْنِتْ جَيِّدٍ.
وَفْقًا لِدِرَاسَةٍ حَدِيثَةٍ، يَتَفَوَّقُ مُسْتَعْمِلُو التِّقْنِيَّةِ عَلَى أَقْرَانِهِمْ.

writing.prompt: Write ninety to one hundred words reporting a research study or a panel on education. Use at least four different reporting verbs, choose إِنَّ or أَنَّ correctly, replace pronouns, and include one past and one future reported statement.
checklist: إِنَّ only after قَالَ; أَنَّ after the other verbs.
The noun after the particle is accusative.
Third-person pronouns replace first-person ones.
One reported past statement and one reported future statement.
writing.model: أَجْرَتْ دِرَاسَةٌ حَدِيثَةٌ بَحْثًا حَوْلَ التَّعْلِيمِ الرَّقْمِيِّ. قَالَ البَاحِثُ الرَّئِيسِيُّ إِنَّ التِّقْنِيَّةَ تُوَفِّرُ فُرَصًا جَدِيدَةً، وَأَضَافَ أَنَّ الطُّلَّابَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَعْمَلُوهَا تَفَوَّقُوا عَلَى أَقْرَانِهِمْ. وَأَوْضَحَ التَّقْرِيرُ أَنَّ التَّعَلُّمَ عَنْ بُعْدٍ سَيَنْتَشِرُ أَكْثَرَ فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ. وَأَشَارَ الخُبَرَاءُ إِلَى أَنَّ المَنَاهِجَ يَجِبُ أَنْ تَتَطَوَّرَ، بَيْنَمَا اِعْتَرَفَ أَحَدُهُمْ بِأَنَّ الفَجْوَةَ الرَّقْمِيَّةَ مَا زَالَتْ مَوْجُودَةً. وَفْقًا لِلدِّرَاسَةِ، خَلَصَ البَاحِثُونَ إِلَى أَنَّ التِّقْنِيَّةَ أَدَاةٌ لَا بَدِيلٌ عَنِ المُعَلِّمِ. وَقَالَتِ البَاحِثَةُ إِنَّهَا سَتُوَاصِلُ دِرَاسَةَ المَوْضُوعِ.

lessons.title: University Life and Higher Education
lessons.summary: Describe university life and use the past perfect (كَانَ قَدْ + past) to place one past action before another in an educational narrative.
objectives: Name the parts of university life in academic Arabic.
Form the past perfect كَانَ قَدْ + past for all persons.
Agree كَانَ / كَانَتْ with the subject and keep the second verb past.
Write a university personal statement using the past perfect.
success: I use كَانَ قَدْ to mark an action completed before another past action.
I make كَانَ / كَانَتْ / كَانُوا agree with the subject.
I keep the verb after قَدْ in the past tense.
I link two past events with بِحُلُولِ or قَبْلَ أَنْ.

teach.title: كَانَ قَدْ marks the earlier of two past actions
teach.text: كَانَ قَدْ أَنْهَى دِرَاسَتَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْدَأَ العَمَلَ — he had finished his studies before he started work. كَانَ / كَانَتْ agrees with the subject, قَدْ follows, and the main verb stays past.

teach.title: Agree كَانَ and keep the verb past
teach.text: كَانَتْ قَدْ حَصَلَتْ عَلَى مِنْحَةٍ (she had obtained a scholarship): كَانَتْ is feminine to match, and حَصَلَتْ stays past. For plurals: كَانُوا قَدْ تَخَرَّجُوا. For the first person: كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْهَيْتُ.

grammar.title: The past perfect كَانَ قَدْ
grammar.overview: كَانَ قَدْ + a past verb expresses an action completed before another past action — the temporal-depth marker of strong narrative writing.

rules.heading: The form
rules.explanation: كَانَ agrees with the subject; the main verb stays past.

rules.heading: All persons
rules.explanation: The كَانَ part inflects for person and number.

rules.heading: Linking two past events
rules.explanation: The past-perfect clause is the earlier action.
examples: كَانَ قَدْ حَصَلَ عَلَى مِنْحَةٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَافِرَ

rules.heading: Framing with بِحُلُولِ
rules.explanation: “By the time of …, he had already …”.
examples: بِحُلُولِ نِهَايَةِ الثَّانَوِيَّةِ، كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْجَزْتُ مَشْرُوعًا بَحْثِيًّا

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate past perfect.
quiz.feedback: The verb after قَدْ stays in the past.

quiz.prompt: Complete for a girl: ___ قَدْ حَصَلَتْ عَلَى مِنْحَةٍ.
quiz.feedback: كَانَتْ agrees with the feminine subject.

quiz.prompt: Complete for “I”: ___ قَدْ أَنْهَيْتُ بَحْثِي.
quiz.feedback: كُنْتُ is the first-person form.

quiz.prompt: Complete for a plural: ___ قَدْ تَخَرَّجُوا قَبْلَ الأَزْمَةِ.
quiz.feedback: كَانُوا agrees with the plural subject.

quiz.prompt: Which links two past events correctly?
options: كَانَ قَدْ حَصَلَ عَلَى مِنْحَةٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَافِرَ.
كَانَ قَدْ يَحْصُلُ عَلَى مِنْحَةٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَافِرَ.
كَانَ سَيَحْصُلُ عَلَى مِنْحَةٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَافِرَ.
quiz.feedback: The earlier action uses كَانَ قَدْ + past.

quiz.prompt: Complete: بِحُلُولِ التَّخَرُّجِ، ___ قَدْ نَشَرَتْ بَحْثَيْنِ.
quiz.feedback: كَانَتْ agrees with the feminine subject.

quiz.prompt: Which verb form follows قَبْلَ أَنْ?
quiz.feedback: قَبْلَ أَنْ is followed by a subjunctive present verb.

quiz.prompt: Which sentence shows temporal depth?
options: كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْهَيْتُ المُرَاجَعَةَ قَبْلَ الامْتِحَانِ.
quiz.feedback: It places one past action before another with كَانَ قَدْ.

grammar.common_error: Using a present verb after قَدْ, or failing to agree كَانَ / كَانَتْ with the subject. The second verb is past, and كَانَ inflects.
grammar.challenge: Write two past-perfect sentences linked to a later action with قَبْلَ أَنْ or بِحُلُولِ.

mistakes.why: The verb after قَدْ must be past.
كَانَ must agree with the feminine subject: كَانَتْ.

mistakes.wrong: كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْهَيْتُ بَحْثِي قَبْلَ أَنْ بَدَأْتُ العَمَلَ.
mistakes.right: كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْهَيْتُ بَحْثِي قَبْلَ أَنْ أَبْدَأَ العَمَلَ.
mistakes.why: قَبْلَ أَنْ is followed by a subjunctive, not a past verb.

listening.title: Listening: a graduate's journey
listening.script: تَقُولُ لَيْلَى: بِحُلُولِ نِهَايَةِ المَرْحَلَةِ الثَّانَوِيَّةِ، كُنْتُ قَدْ قَرَّرْتُ دِرَاسَةَ الطِّبِّ. كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْجَزْتُ مَشْرُوعًا بَحْثِيًّا فِي عِلْمِ الأَحْيَاءِ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَلْتَحِقَ بِالجَامِعَةِ. وَفِي السَّنَةِ الأُولَى، كَانَتْ زَمِيلَتِي قَدْ حَصَلَتْ عَلَى مِنْحَةٍ دِرَاسِيَّةٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَبْدَأَ الفَصْلَ. أَمَّا أَخِي فَكَانَ قَدْ عَمِلَ سَنَةً كَامِلَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقَرِّرَ التَّخَصُّصَ. وَبِحُلُولِ التَّخَرُّجِ، كُنَّا قَدْ حَضَرْنَا عَشَرَاتِ المُحَاضَرَاتِ وَالنَّدَوَاتِ. أَدْرَكْتُ حِينَهَا أَنَّ الاِسْتِقْلَالِيَّةَ وَإِدَارَةَ الضَّغْطِ الأَكَادِيمِيِّ لَا تَقِلَّانِ أَهَمِّيَّةً عَنِ الدِّرَاسَةِ نَفْسِهَا.

questions.prompt: What had Layla decided by the end of secondary school?
questions.feedback: كُنْتُ قَدْ قَرَّرْتُ دِرَاسَةَ الطِّبِّ.

questions.prompt: What had she done before enrolling at university?
questions.feedback: كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْجَزْتُ مَشْرُوعًا بَحْثِيًّا … قَبْلَ أَنْ أَلْتَحِقَ بِالجَامِعَةِ.

questions.prompt: What had her classmate done before the term began?
questions.feedback: كَانَتْ زَمِيلَتِي قَدْ حَصَلَتْ عَلَى مِنْحَةٍ … قَبْلَ أَنْ تَبْدَأَ الفَصْلَ.

questions.prompt: What had her brother done before choosing a specialism?
questions.feedback: كَانَ قَدْ عَمِلَ سَنَةً كَامِلَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقَرِّرَ التَّخَصُّصَ.

questions.prompt: What did she realise about independence and pressure?
options: They are no less important than study itself
They are the only thing that matters
questions.feedback: لَا تَقِلَّانِ أَهَمِّيَّةً عَنِ الدِّرَاسَةِ نَفْسِهَا.

reading.title: Reading: more than lectures
reading.text: لَا تَقْتَصِرُ الحَيَاةُ الجَامِعِيَّةُ عَلَى المُحَاضَرَاتِ وَالبُحُوثِ. فَبِحُلُولِ نِهَايَةِ السَّنَةِ الأُولَى، يَكُونُ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ الطُّلَّابِ قَدِ اكْتَسَبُوا اسْتِقْلَالِيَّةً لَمْ تَكُنْ لَدَيْهِمْ سَابِقًا. كَثِيرُونَ كَانُوا قَدِ اعْتَمَدُوا عَلَى أُسَرِهِمْ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمُوا إِدَارَةَ الوَقْتِ وَالمَالِ. وَالأَنْشِطَةُ اللَّامَنْهَجِيَّةُ وَالعَمَلُ التَّطَوُّعِيُّ يُضِيفَانِ خِبْرَةً عَمَلِيَّةً قَيِّمَةً. لٰكِنَّ الجَامِعَةَ تَحْمِلُ ضَغْطًا أَكَادِيمِيًّا حَقِيقِيًّا؛ فَمَنْ كَانَ قَدْ تَعَلَّمَ تَنْظِيمَ وَقْتِهِ مُبَكِّرًا وَاجَهَ الضَّغْطَ بِثِقَةٍ أَكْبَرَ. وَفِي رَأْيِي، إِذَا وَازَنَ الطَّالِبُ بَيْنَ الدِّرَاسَةِ وَالحَيَاةِ، فَسَيَنْجَحُ فِي كِلَيْهِمَا.

questions.prompt: What is university life not limited to?
questions.feedback: لَا تَقْتَصِرُ … عَلَى المُحَاضَرَاتِ وَالبُحُوثِ.

questions.prompt: What have many students gained by the end of the first year?
options: Independence they did not have before
questions.feedback: قَدِ اكْتَسَبُوا اسْتِقْلَالِيَّةً لَمْ تَكُنْ لَدَيْهِمْ سَابِقًا.

questions.prompt: What do extracurriculars and volunteering add?
questions.feedback: يُضِيفَانِ خِبْرَةً عَمَلِيَّةً قَيِّمَةً.

questions.prompt: Who faced academic pressure more confidently?
options: Those who had learned to organise time early
questions.feedback: مَنْ كَانَ قَدْ تَعَلَّمَ تَنْظِيمَ وَقْتِهِ مُبَكِّرًا وَاجَهَ الضَّغْطَ بِثِقَةٍ أَكْبَرَ.

questions.prompt: What does the writer conclude about balance?
options: Balancing study and life leads to success in both
questions.feedback: إِذَا وَازَنَ الطَّالِبُ بَيْنَ الدِّرَاسَةِ وَالحَيَاةِ، فَسَيَنْجَحُ فِي كِلَيْهِمَا.

مَاذَا كُنْتَ قَدْ فَعَلْتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْتَارَ تَخَصُّصَكَ؟

writing.prompt: Write one hundred to one hundred and ten words as a university personal statement. Use the past perfect (كَانَ قَدْ) at least twice for prior achievements, a reported-speech clause about what a teacher said, and a Type 1 conditional about the future.
checklist: Two past-perfect sentences with correct كَانَ agreement.
One reported-speech clause (قَالَ / أَشَارَ … أَنَّ).
One Type 1 conditional about the future.
Present-tense description of your current situation.
writing.model: كُنْتُ قَدْ قَرَّرْتُ دِرَاسَةَ الطِّبِّ مُنْذُ المَرْحَلَةِ الإِعْدَادِيَّةِ. وَبِحُلُولِ نِهَايَةِ الثَّانَوِيَّةِ، كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْجَزْتُ مَشْرُوعًا بَحْثِيًّا فِي عِلْمِ الأَحْيَاءِ وَحَصَلْتُ عَلَى خِبْرَةٍ فِي مُسْتَشْفًى مَحَلِّيٍّ. أَدْرُسُ الآنَ فِي السَّنَةِ الأَخِيرَةِ وَأَتَفَوَّقُ فِي العُلُومِ وَالرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ. أَشَارَ أُسْتَاذِي إِلَى أَنَّنِي مُجْتَهِدٌ وَأَكَّدَ أَنَّنِي سَأَكُونُ طَبِيبًا جَيِّدًا. أَطْمَحُ إِلَى الاِلْتِحَاقِ بِكُلِّيَّةِ الطِّبِّ فِي جَامِعَتِكُمْ، وَإِذَا قُبِلْتُ، سَأُكَرِّسُ جُهْدِي لِلْبَحْثِ العِلْمِيِّ. أُدْرِكُ أَنَّ الاِسْتِقْلَالِيَّةَ وَإِدَارَةَ الضَّغْطِ الأَكَادِيمِيِّ ضَرُورِيَّتَانِ لِلنَّجَاحِ فِي الحَيَاةِ الجَامِعِيَّةِ.

lessons.summary: Describe effective study strategies with Bloom's taxonomy verbs (يُطَبِّقُ، يُحَلِّلُ، يُقَيِّمُ، يُبْدِعُ) and link study habits to outcomes with the conditional.
objectives: Name study strategies in academic Arabic.
Use Bloom's taxonomy verbs from remembering to creating.
Link a study habit to its outcome with a Type 1 conditional.
Write an academic-magazine study guide.
success: I use Form II and IV study verbs with direct objects.
I order the cognitive levels from يَتَذَكَّرُ up to يُبْدِعُ.
I connect a habit to a result rather than listing tips.
I contrast effective and ineffective study with بَيْنَمَا.

teach.title: Bloom's verbs climb from remembering to creating
teach.text: The cognitive levels rise: يَتَذَكَّرُ → يَفْهَمُ → يُطَبِّقُ → يُحَلِّلُ → يُقَيِّمُ → يُبْدِعُ. The higher levels are mostly Form II or IV verbs with a direct object: يُحَلِّلُ النَّصَّ، يُقَيِّمُ كِتَابَتَهُ، يُبْدِعُ نَصًّا جَدِيدًا.

teach.title: Connect a habit to its outcome
teach.text: A study guide is stronger when it links cause to effect: إِذَا رَاجَعْتَ المَادَّةَ أُسْبُوعِيًّا، سَتَحْتَفِظُ بِالمَعْلُومَاتِ أَفْضَلَ. That is worth more than naming a strategy on its own.

listening.title: Listening: how to study well
listening.script: تُوصِي الأَبْحَاثُ بِأَنْ يُنَظِّمَ الطَّالِبُ وَقْتَهُ أَوَّلًا. هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَعْمِلُونَ المُرَاجَعَةَ المُتَبَاعِدَةَ يَتَفَوَّقُونَ عَلَى أَقْرَانِهِمْ؟ الطَّرِيقَةُ الفَعَّالَةُ لَا تَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى الحِفْظِ عَنْ ظَهْرِ قَلْبٍ، بَلْ عَلَى الفَهْمِ العَمِيقِ. فَإِذَا لَخَّصْتَ المَادَّةَ بِكَلِمَاتِكَ، سَتَحْتَفِظُ بِهَا أَطْوَلَ. وَأَكَّدَ عُلَمَاءُ التَّرْبِيَةِ أَنَّ الطَّالِبَ الَّذِي يَسْتَعْمِلُ هَرَمَ بْلُومَ يَصِلُ إِلَى مُسْتَوَيَاتِ التَّفْكِيرِ العُلْيَا. وَبَيْنَمَا يُضْعِفُ التَّشْتِيتُ التَّرْكِيزَ، تُعَزِّزُ البِيئَةُ الهَادِئَةُ الإِنْتَاجِيَّةَ. اِبْدَأْ بِخُطْوَةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ اليَوْمَ.

reading.title: Reading: learning is a skill
reading.text: لَيْسَ النَّجَاحُ الأَكَادِيمِيُّ مَوْهِبَةً فَقَطْ، بَلْ مَهَارَةٌ تُكْتَسَبُ. فَالطَّالِبُ النَّاجِحُ يُنَظِّمُ وَقْتَهُ، وَيُلَخِّصُ المَادَّةَ، وَيُرَاجِعُهَا عَلَى فَتَرَاتٍ مُتَبَاعِدَةٍ. وَتُشِيرُ الأَبْحَاثُ إِلَى أَنَّ التَّسْمِيعَ الذَّاتِيَّ أَقْوَى مِنْ إِعَادَةِ القِرَاءَةِ. أَمَّا الحِفْظُ عَنْ ظَهْرِ قَلْبٍ فَيُؤَدِّي إِلَى نِسْيَانٍ سَرِيعٍ، بَيْنَمَا يُؤَدِّي الفَهْمُ العَمِيقُ إِلَى احْتِفَاظٍ طَوِيلِ الأَمَدِ. وَإِذَا اسْتَعْمَلَ الطَّالِبُ التَّفْكِيرَ العَالِي — أَنْ يُحَلِّلَ وَيُقَيِّمَ وَيُبْدِعَ — فَسَيَفْهَمُ أَعْمَقَ. وَلَيْسَ الهَدَفُ جَمْعَ المَعْلُومَاتِ، بَلْ التَّعَلُّمَ كَيْفَ نُفَكِّرُ.

lessons.title: Career Aspirations and the Future of Work
lessons.summary: Talk about careers and the future of work, integrating the past perfect, reported speech, the conditional and the future, with يُؤَهِّلُ لِـ and يُعِدُّ لِـ.
objectives: Describe career ambitions and the future of work, including AI.
Use يُؤَهِّلُ لِـ، يُعِدُّ لِـ and يَتَحَوَّلُ إِلَى with correct complements.
Integrate past perfect, reported speech, conditional and future in one text.
Argue which jobs AI will and will not replace.
success: I follow يُؤَهِّلُ and يُعِدُّ with لِـ, and يَتَحَوَّلُ with إِلَى.
I combine at least three P2 structures in one paragraph.
I keep إِنَّ / أَنَّ and كَانَ قَدْ accurate under integration.
I discuss AI's impact with balanced, hedged language.

teach.title: يُؤَهِّلُ and يُعِدُّ take لِـ; يَتَحَوَّلُ takes إِلَى
teach.text: التَّعْلِيمُ يُؤَهِّلُنِي لِسُوقِ العَمَلِ، وَالجَامِعَةُ تُعِدُّنِي لِلْمُنَافَسَةِ, while الذَّكَاءُ الاِصْطِنَاعِيُّ يَتَحَوَّلُ إِلَى شَرِيكٍ. Learn each verb with its complement.

teach.title: Integrate the P2 toolkit in one text
teach.text: A P2-standard paragraph combines كَانَ قَدْ (background), قَالَ / أَشَارَ … أَنَّ (what others say), a conditional (إِذَا … سَـ) and the future (سَوْفَ). Weaving several structures together is what marks the strongest writing.

grammar.title: Integrating the P2 grammar
grammar.overview: New career verbs with their complements, and how to combine the past perfect, reported speech, the conditional and the future in a single argument.

rules.heading: Career verbs
rules.formula: يُؤَهِّلُ لِـ · يُعِدُّ لِـ · يَتَحَوَّلُ إِلَى
rules.explanation: Two take لِـ; one takes إِلَى.

rules.heading: Background with past perfect
rules.explanation: Open with what had already happened.
examples: كُنْتُ قَدْ قَرَّرْتُ مَسِيرَتِي مُنْذُ صِغَرِي

rules.heading: Cite others with reported speech
rules.explanation: Report what a mentor or study says.
examples: أَشَارَ مُرْشِدِي إِلَى أَنَّ الذَّكَاءَ الاِصْطِنَاعِيَّ لَنْ يَسْتَبْدِلَ المُبْدِعِينَ

rules.heading: Plan with conditional and future

listening.script: قَالَ المُرْشِدُ الوَظِيفِيُّ إِنَّ سُوقَ العَمَلِ يَتَغَيَّرُ بِسُرْعَةٍ. وَأَضَافَ أَنَّ الذَّكَاءَ الاِصْطِنَاعِيَّ سَيَسْتَبْدِلُ بَعْضَ الوَظَائِفِ الرُّوتِينِيَّةِ، لٰكِنَّهُ لَنْ يَسْتَبْدِلَ الوَظَائِفَ الَّتِي تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى إِبْدَاعٍ وَتَعَاطُفٍ. وَأَشَارَ إِلَى أَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ الجَيِّدَ يُؤَهِّلُ الشَّبَابَ لِسُوقٍ تَنَافُسِيٍّ، وَأَنَّ الجَامِعَةَ تُعِدُّهُمْ لِمُوَاكَبَةِ التَّغْيِيرِ. كَثِيرٌ مِنَ الطُّلَّابِ كَانُوا قَدْ حَدَّدُوا مَسَارَهُمْ مُبَكِّرًا، ثُمَّ غَيَّرُوهُ بَعْدَ اكْتِشَافِ مَهَارَاتٍ جَدِيدَةٍ. وَقَالَ إِنَّ مَهَارَةَ التَّكَيُّفِ هِيَ الأَهَمُّ. وَخَلَصَ إِلَى أَنَّهُ إِذَا طَوَّرَ الطَّالِبُ تَفْكِيرَهُ النَّقْدِيَّ، فَسَيَجِدُ مَكَانَهُ فِي أَيِّ سُوقٍ.

reading.title: Reading: which jobs will AI change?
reading.text: يَرَى كَثِيرٌ مِنَ الخُبَرَاءِ أَنَّ الذَّكَاءَ الاِصْطِنَاعِيَّ سَيُعِيدُ تَشْكِيلَ سُوقِ العَمَلِ لَا إِنْهَاءَهُ. فَبَعْضُ الوَظَائِفِ الرُّوتِينِيَّةِ سَيَتَوَلَّاهَا الحَاسُوبُ، فِي حِينِ أَنَّ الوَظَائِفَ الَّتِي تَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى الإِبْدَاعِ وَالتَّعَاطُفِ سَتَبْقَى لِلْبَشَرِ. وَأَشَارَتْ دِرَاسَةٌ حَدِيثَةٌ إِلَى أَنَّ مَهَارَةَ التَّكَيُّفِ سَتُصْبِحُ أَهَمَّ مِنَ الشَّهَادَةِ وَحْدَهَا. وَالتَّعْلِيمُ الجَيِّدُ يُؤَهِّلُ الطَّالِبَ لِهٰذَا التَّغْيِيرِ وَيُعِدُّهُ لِمِهَنٍ لَمْ تُوجَدْ بَعْدُ. وَإِذَا رَكَّزَ الشَّبَابُ عَلَى التَّفْكِيرِ النَّقْدِيِّ وَحَلِّ المَشْكِلَاتِ، فَسَيَتَحَوَّلُ الذَّكَاءُ الاِصْطِنَاعِيُّ إِلَى أَدَاةٍ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ لَا خَطَرٍ عَلَيْهِمْ. وَلَيْسَ المُهِمُّ مُقَاوَمَةَ التَّغْيِيرِ، بَلْ مُوَاكَبَتَهُ.

writing.prompt: Write one hundred and ten to one hundred and twenty words on your career aspirations and the future of work. Integrate all four P2 structures: a past perfect for background, reported speech for what a mentor says, a Type 1 conditional and the future — and use يُؤَهِّلُ لِـ or يُعِدُّ لِـ.
checklist: A past-perfect background sentence (كُنْتُ قَدْ …).
A reported-speech clause (قَالَ إِنَّ / أَشَارَ … أَنَّ).

lessons.title: Education and Social Mobility
lessons.summary: The P2 second milestone: argue about education and equality with the Type 2 conditional (لَوْ + past → لَـ + past), the language of the hypothetical.
objectives: Discuss education and social mobility in argumentative register.
Form the Type 2 conditional: لَوْ + past → لَـ + past.
Distinguish the real إِذَا conditional from the hypothetical لَوْ conditional.

success: I use a past verb after لَوْ and mark the result with لَـ.

I cite an argument with reported speech.

teach.title: Type 2: لَوْ + past → لَـ + past
teach.text: لَوْ كَانَ التَّعْلِيمُ مَجَّانِيًّا، لَوَصَلَ الجَمِيعُ إِلَى الجَامِعَةِ — if education had been free, everyone would have reached university. A past verb follows لَوْ, and the result verb takes a لَـ prefix. It implies the opposite was actually true (education was not free).

teach.title: إِذَا is real; لَوْ is hypothetical
teach.text: إِذَا ضَمِنَتِ الحُكُومَاتُ التَّعْلِيمَ، سَيَتَحَسَّنُ الوَضْعُ describes a real, possible future. لَوْ ضَمِنَتِ الحُكُومَاتُ التَّعْلِيمَ، لَتَحَسَّنَ الوَضْعُ imagines an unreal past that did not happen. Choose إِذَا for a real proposal and لَوْ for a counterfactual.

grammar.title: The Type 2 conditional and its contrast with Type 1
grammar.overview: لَوْ + past → لَـ + past expresses a hypothetical, often counterfactual, condition. It contrasts with the real إِذَا … سَـ conditional of P1.

rules.heading: The Type 2 form
rules.explanation: Past verb after لَوْ; the result verb carries a لَـ prefix.
examples: لَوْ كَانَ التَّعْلِيمُ مَجَّانِيًّا، لَوَصَلَ الجَمِيعُ

rules.heading: Type 1 vs Type 2
rules.formula: إِذَا + past → سَـ  ·  لَوْ + past → لَـ
rules.explanation: إِذَا is real and future; لَوْ is unreal and counterfactual.
examples: لَوِ اجْتَهَدْتَ، لَنَجَحْتَ (but you did not)

rules.heading: Argument with a counterfactual
rules.explanation: Use لَوْ to argue about the road not taken.
examples: لَوْ أُتِيحَتِ الفُرَصُ لِلْجَمِيعِ، لَتَغَيَّرَ وَجْهُ المُجْتَمَعِ

rules.heading: Balancing a claim
rules.explanation: State a view, then a hypothetical counter.
examples: يُجَادِلُ المُنْتَقِدُونَ بِأَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ الخَاصَّ يُكَرِّسُ الامْتِيَازَ

quiz.feedback: A real future proposal uses إِذَا … سَـ.

quiz.prompt: Which reports a counter-argument accurately?
options: يُجَادِلُ المُنْتَقِدُونَ بِأَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ الخَاصَّ يُكَرِّسُ الامْتِيَازَ.

quiz.feedback: يُجَادِلُ بِأَنَّ with an accusative noun.

quiz.prompt: What does a Type 2 conditional usually imply?
quiz.feedback: لَوْ marks a counterfactual: the condition did not hold.

grammar.common_error: Using a present or future verb after لَوْ, or forgetting the لَـ on the result. Also do not mix the types: لَوْ never takes سَـ in the result.
grammar.challenge: Write one real proposal with إِذَا and one counterfactual with لَوْ about the same idea.

listening.title: Listening: is education the great equaliser?
listening.script: يَرَى كَثِيرٌ مِنْ عُلَمَاءِ التَّرْبِيَةِ أَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ هُوَ المُحَرِّكُ الرَّئِيسِيُّ لِلْحَرَاكِ الاِجْتِمَاعِيِّ. وَأَشَارَ تَقْرِيرٌ دَوْلِيٌّ إِلَى أَنَّ كُلَّ سَنَةٍ إِضَافِيَّةٍ مِنَ التَّعْلِيمِ تَزِيدُ دَخْلَ الفَرْدِ. لٰكِنَّ المُنْتَقِدِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ بِأَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ وَحْدَهُ لَا يُسَاوِي. لَوْ كَانَ التَّعْلِيمُ الجَيِّدُ مُتَاحًا لِلْجَمِيعِ بِالتَّسَاوِي، لَقَلَّتِ الفَجْوَةُ بَيْنَ الطَّبَقَاتِ. فِي الوَاقِعِ، غَالِبًا مَا يُكَرِّسُ التَّعْلِيمُ الخَاصُّ الامْتِيَازَ الاِجْتِمَاعِيَّ. وَمِنْ وِجْهَةِ نَظَرِي، إِذَا ضَمِنَتِ الحُكُومَاتُ جَوْدَةَ التَّعْلِيمِ لِلْجَمِيعِ، سَيُصْبِحُ التَّعْلِيمُ مُحَرِّكًا حَقِيقِيًّا لِلْمُسَاوَاةِ. لَوِ اسْتُثْمِرَ فِي المَدَارِسِ الفَقِيرَةِ مُبَكِّرًا، لَارْتَقَى كَثِيرُونَ.

reading.title: Reading: a balanced argument
reading.text: هَلْ يُحَقِّقُ التَّعْلِيمُ المُسَاوَاةَ الاِجْتِمَاعِيَّةَ؟ يَرَى المُؤَيِّدُونَ أَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ يَتَجَاوَزُ الفَوَارِقَ وَيُتِيحُ لِلْفَقِيرِ أَنْ يَرْتَقِيَ. وَأَكَّدَتْ دِرَاسَاتٌ أَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ يُكَافِئُ الاِجْتِهَادَ لَا الأَصْلَ. لٰكِنَّ المُنْتَقِدِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ بِأَنَّ الوَاقِعَ أَكْثَرُ تَعْقِيدًا؛ فَلَوْ كَانَتِ الفُرَصُ مُتَكَافِئَةً حَقًّا، لَمَا بَقِيَتِ الفَجْوَةُ بَيْنَ الطَّبَقَاتِ. وَفِي الوَاقِعِ، يُدِيمُ التَّعْلِيمُ الخَاصُّ الامْتِيَازَ أَحْيَانًا. عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ، يَبْقَى التَّعْلِيمُ أَقْوَى أَدَاةٍ لِلْحَرَاكِ. وَإِذَا اسْتَثْمَرَتِ الدَّوْلَةُ فِي المَدَارِسِ الضَّعِيفَةِ، سَتَضِيقُ الفَجْوَةُ تَدْرِيجِيًّا.

questions.prompt: What is the critics' counterfactual argument?
options: If opportunities were truly equal, the class gap would not remain
questions.feedback: لَوْ كَانَتِ الفُرَصُ مُتَكَافِئَةً حَقًّا، لَمَا بَقِيَتِ الفَجْوَةُ.

questions.feedback: يُدِيمُ التَّعْلِيمُ الخَاصُّ الامْتِيَازَ أَحْيَانًا.

options: Investing in weak schools will gradually narrow the gap

وَلَوِ اسْتُثْمِرَ فِي المَدَارِسِ الفَقِيرَةِ مُبَكِّرًا، لَتَغَيَّرَ الوَاقِعُ
وَإِذَا ضَمِنَتِ الحُكُومَاتُ الجَوْدَةَ لِلْجَمِيعِ، سَيُصْبِحُ التَّعْلِيمُ مُحَرِّكًا لِلْمُسَاوَاةِ
وَإِذَا زَادَ الإِنْفَاقُ عَلَى المَدَارِسِ الضَّعِيفَةِ، سَتَضِيقُ الفَجْوَةُ
وَمِنْ وِجْهَةِ نَظَرِي، يَبْقَى التَّعْلِيمُ أَقْوَى أَدَاةٍ لِلْحَرَاكِ
live_builder.feedback: Each reported claim, counterfactual and real proposal is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations work.

builder_tasks.title: Fix the Type 2 result
builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the result so it uses لَـ, not سَـ.
builder_tasks.feedback: A Type 2 result takes the لَـ prefix on a past verb.

builder_tasks.title: Fix the verb after لَوْ
builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the verb tense after لَوْ.
builder_tasks.feedback: لَوْ is followed by a past-tense verb.

builder_tasks.title: Real or hypothetical? Choose إِذَا or لَوْ
builder_tasks.instruction: Pick the version that uses إِذَا for a real future proposal and لَوْ for a counterfactual about the past.
builder_tasks.context: You are arguing about school funding. One clause proposes a real change for next year; the other imagines an unreal past that did not happen. Match each to the right conditional: إِذَا (real) or لَوْ (hypothetical).
options: إِذَا زَادَ الإِنْفَاقُ العَامَ القَادِمَ، سَتَقِلُّ الفَجْوَةُ؛ وَلَوْ زَادَ الإِنْفَاقُ سَابِقًا، لَقَلَّتِ الفَجْوَةُ.
لَوْ زَادَ الإِنْفَاقُ العَامَ القَادِمَ، سَتَقِلُّ الفَجْوَةُ؛ وَإِذَا زَادَ سَابِقًا، لَقَلَّتِ الفَجْوَةُ.
إِذَا زَادَ الإِنْفَاقُ سَابِقًا، لَقَلَّتِ الفَجْوَةُ؛ وَلَوْ زَادَ الإِنْفَاقُ العَامَ القَادِمَ، سَتَقِلُّ.
builder_tasks.feedback: إِذَا … سَـ for the real future proposal; لَوْ … لَـ for the unreal past. The correct version keeps each conditional in its right role.

lessons.title: Education in the Arab World — History and Change
lessons.arabic: التَّعْلِيمُ فِي العَالَمِ العَرَبِيِّ — التَّارِيخُ وَالتَّغْيِيرُ
lessons.summary: Trace the history of Arab education — the Golden Age with the past perfect, later decline and reform with the simple past, and today's challenges in the present.
objectives: Narrate the Golden Age with the past perfect (كَانَ قَدْ).
Use the simple past for later historical events.
Describe contemporary challenges in the present with statistics.
Combine both conditional types in a historical argument.
success: I use كَانَ قَدْ for achievements completed before a later past point.
I move from past perfect to simple past to present as the timeline advances.
I cite historians with reported speech.
I contrast a real proposal (إِذَا) with a counterfactual (لَوْ).

teach.title: Past perfect for the earliest achievements
teach.text: بِحُلُولِ القَرْنِ التَّاسِعِ، كَانَ العَرَبُ قَدْ طَوَّرُوا أَنْظِمَةً تَعْلِيمِيَّةً مُتَقَدِّمَةً — by the ninth century, the Arabs had developed advanced systems. Use كَانَ قَدْ for what had already happened before a later point in the story.

teach.title: Move the tense as the timeline advances
teach.text: Golden Age: كَانَ قَدْ أَسَّسَ (past perfect). Decline: اِنْحَطَّ التَّعْلِيمُ (simple past). Today: يَشْهَدُ التَّعْلِيمُ إِصْلَاحَاتٍ (present). Matching the tense to the period is what makes historical narrative read clearly.

grammar.title: Tense across a historical timeline
grammar.overview: Past perfect for the earliest achievements, simple past for later events, present for today, and both conditional types for analysis.

rules.heading: Past perfect: earliest layer
rules.explanation: Achievements completed before a later past point.
examples: كَانَ العَرَبُ قَدْ أَسَّسُوا نِظَامًا عَالَمِيًّا
كَانَتْ دَارُ الحِكْمَةِ قَدِ اسْتَقْطَبَتْ عُلَمَاءَ

rules.heading: Simple past: later events
rules.explanation: Straight past for events that follow.

rules.heading: Present: today's challenges
rules.explanation: Present tense for current reality, often with statistics.

rules.heading: Analysis with both conditionals
rules.explanation: Counterfactual for the past, real proposal for the future.
examples: لَوِ اسْتَثْمَرَ العَالَمُ العَرَبِيُّ مُبَكِّرًا، لَكَانَ وَضْعُهُ مُخْتَلِفًا

quiz.prompt: Which tense fits the Golden Age achievement?
options: كَانَ العَرَبُ قَدْ أَسَّسُوا نِظَامًا مُتَقَدِّمًا.
quiz.feedback: The earliest achievement takes the past perfect كَانَ قَدْ.

quiz.prompt: Which is the simple past for a later event?
quiz.feedback: A later historical event takes the simple past.

quiz.prompt: Which fits today's challenges?
quiz.feedback: Current reality takes the present tense.

quiz.prompt: Complete: كَانَتْ دَارُ الحِكْمَةِ قَدِ ___ عُلَمَاءَ.
quiz.feedback: The verb after قَدْ is past, agreeing with the feminine subject.

quiz.prompt: Which reports a historian accurately?
options: أَشَارَ المُؤَرِّخُونَ إِلَى أَنَّ دَارَ الحِكْمَةِ جَمَعَتْ عُلَمَاءَ.
أَشَارَ المُؤَرِّخُونَ أَنَّ دَارَ الحِكْمَةِ جَمَعَتْ عُلَمَاءَ.
أَشَارَ المُؤَرِّخُونَ إِلَى إِنَّ دَارَ الحِكْمَةِ.
quiz.feedback: أَشَارَ إِلَى أَنَّ with an accusative noun.

quiz.prompt: Which is the counterfactual analysis (Type 2)?
options: لَوِ اسْتَثْمَرَ العَالَمُ العَرَبِيُّ مُبَكِّرًا، لَكَانَ وَضْعُهُ مُخْتَلِفًا.
إِذَا اسْتَثْمَرَ العَالَمُ العَرَبِيُّ، سَيَتَحَسَّنُ الوَضْعُ.
quiz.feedback: لَوْ … لَـ imagines an unreal past.

quiz.prompt: Complete: تَمُرُّ مَنَاطِقُ النِّزَاعِ ___ أَزَمَاتٍ تَعْلِيمِيَّةٍ.
quiz.feedback: يَمُرُّ is fixed with بِـ.

quiz.prompt: Which orders the tenses correctly across time?
options: كَانَ العَرَبُ قَدْ أَسَّسُوا، ثُمَّ انْحَطَّ التَّعْلِيمُ، وَاليَوْمَ يَشْهَدُ إِصْلَاحَاتٍ.
يَشْهَدُ العَرَبُ، ثُمَّ كَانُوا قَدْ أَسَّسُوا، ثُمَّ سَيَنْحَطُّ.
سَيُؤَسِّسُ العَرَبُ ثُمَّ انْحَطَّ ثُمَّ يَشْهَدُ.
quiz.feedback: Past perfect → simple past → present follows the timeline.

grammar.common_error: Using the present for a Golden-Age achievement, or the past perfect for today's challenges. Match the tense to the period, and keep يَمُرُّ with بِـ.
grammar.challenge: Write a three-part line: a past-perfect achievement, a present challenge, and a counterfactual with لَوْ.

mistakes.wrong: يُؤَسِّسُ العَرَبُ نِظَامًا مُتَقَدِّمًا فِي العَصْرِ الذَّهَبِيِّ.
mistakes.right: كَانَ العَرَبُ قَدْ أَسَّسُوا نِظَامًا مُتَقَدِّمًا فِي العَصْرِ الذَّهَبِيِّ.
mistakes.why: A Golden-Age achievement takes the past perfect.
يَمُرُّ is fixed with بِـ.

mistakes.right: لَوِ اسْتَثْمَرَ العَالَمُ العَرَبِيُّ مُبَكِّرًا، لَكَانَ وَضْعُهُ مُخْتَلِفًا.
mistakes.why: A Type 2 result takes لَـ, not سَـ.

listening.title: Listening: from the House of Wisdom to today
listening.script: بِحُلُولِ القَرْنِ التَّاسِعِ، كَانَ العَرَبُ قَدْ أَسَّسُوا نِظَامًا تَعْلِيمِيًّا عَالَمِيًّا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُوجَدَ الجَامِعَاتُ الأُورُوبِّيَّةُ. كَانَتْ دَارُ الحِكْمَةِ فِي بَغْدَادَ قَدِ اسْتَقْطَبَتْ عُلَمَاءَ مِنْ ثَقَافَاتٍ مُتَعَدِّدَةٍ، وَازْدَهَرَتِ التَّرْجَمَةُ وَالعُلُومُ. وَأَشَارَ المُؤَرِّخُونَ إِلَى أَنَّ ابْنَ رُشْدَ كَانَ قَدْ كَتَبَ شُرُوحًا أَصْبَحَتْ مَرْجِعًا فِي أُورُوبَّا. ثُمَّ انْحَطَّ التَّعْلِيمُ خِلَالَ فَتَرَاتِ الغَزْوِ، وَتَطَوَّرَ بَعْدَ الاِسْتِقْلَالِ. اليَوْمَ يَشْهَدُ التَّعْلِيمُ العَرَبِيُّ إِصْلَاحَاتٍ، لٰكِنَّ بَعْضَ المَنَاطِقِ تُعَانِي مِنْ مُعَدَّلَاتِ أُمِّيَّةٍ مُرْتَفِعَةٍ. وَلَوِ اسْتُثْمِرَ فِي التَّعْلِيمِ بِنِسْبَةٍ مُوَازِيَةٍ لِلدُّوَلِ المُتَقَدِّمَةِ، لَكَانَ الوَضْعُ العِلْمِيُّ مُخْتَلِفًا.

questions.prompt: What had the Arabs done by the ninth century?
options: Founded a world education system before European universities existed
questions.feedback: كَانَ العَرَبُ قَدْ أَسَّسُوا نِظَامًا … قَبْلَ أَنْ تُوجَدَ الجَامِعَاتُ الأُورُوبِّيَّةُ.

questions.prompt: What had the House of Wisdom done?
questions.feedback: كَانَتْ دَارُ الحِكْمَةِ … قَدِ اسْتَقْطَبَتْ عُلَمَاءَ مِنْ ثَقَافَاتٍ مُتَعَدِّدَةٍ.

questions.prompt: What did historians point out about Ibn Rushd?
options: He had written commentaries that became a reference in Europe
questions.feedback: كَانَ قَدْ كَتَبَ شُرُوحًا أَصْبَحَتْ مَرْجِعًا فِي أُورُوبَّا.

questions.prompt: What happened during the invasions, then after independence?
questions.feedback: انْحَطَّ التَّعْلِيمُ … وَتَطَوَّرَ بَعْدَ الاِسْتِقْلَالِ.

questions.prompt: What is the counterfactual about investment?
options: Had there been parallel investment, the scientific situation would have differed
questions.feedback: لَوِ اسْتُثْمِرَ … لَكَانَ الوَضْعُ العِلْمِيُّ مُخْتَلِفًا.

reading.title: Reading: heritage and today
reading.text: يَحْمِلُ العَالَمُ العَرَبِيُّ مَوْرُوثًا تَعْلِيمِيًّا عَرِيقًا. فَقَدْ كَانَ قَدْ أَسَّسَ أَرْقَى الأَنْظِمَةِ فِي العَالَمِ خِلَالَ العَصْرِ الذَّهَبِيِّ، وَكَانَتِ المُدُنُ مِثْلُ بَغْدَادَ وَقُرْطُبَةَ قَدِ اسْتَقْطَبَتْ عُلَمَاءَ وَمُتَرْجِمِينَ. ثُمَّ مَرَّ التَّعْلِيمُ بِفَتَرَاتِ ضَعْفٍ بَعْدَ الغَزْوِ وَالاِسْتِعْمَارِ. اليَوْمَ، يُشَارُ إِلَى أَنَّ المِنْطَقَةَ تُعَانِي مِنْ فَجَوَاتٍ تَعْلِيمِيَّةٍ، وَمِنْ أَعْلَى مُعَدَّلَاتِ أُمِّيَّةِ الشَّبَابِ فِي بَعْضِ الدُّوَلِ. لٰكِنَّ الإِصْلَاحَاتِ مُسْتَمِرَّةٌ، وَخَاصَّةً فِي تَعْلِيمِ المَرْأَةِ وَتَحْدِيثِ المَنَاهِجِ. وَلَوْ عَادَ الاِسْتِثْمَارُ فِي العِلْمِ كَمَا كَانَ، لَاسْتَعَادَتِ المِنْطَقَةُ رِيَادَتَهَا. وَإِذَا وَاصَلَتِ الدُّوَلُ إِصْلَاحَاتِهَا، سَتَتَقَلَّصُ الفَجْوَةُ.

questions.prompt: What had the Arab world done in the Golden Age?
questions.feedback: كَانَ قَدْ أَسَّسَ أَرْقَى الأَنْظِمَةِ … خِلَالَ العَصْرِ الذَّهَبِيِّ.

questions.prompt: What happened after invasion and colonialism?
options: Education went through periods of weakness
questions.feedback: مَرَّ التَّعْلِيمُ بِفَتَرَاتِ ضَعْفٍ بَعْدَ الغَزْوِ وَالاِسْتِعْمَارِ.

questions.prompt: What is today's reality, per the text?
options: Education gaps and high youth illiteracy in some countries
questions.feedback: تُعَانِي مِنْ فَجَوَاتٍ تَعْلِيمِيَّةٍ، وَمِنْ أَعْلَى مُعَدَّلَاتِ أُمِّيَّةِ الشَّبَابِ.

questions.prompt: Where are reforms especially active?
questions.feedback: وَخَاصَّةً فِي تَعْلِيمِ المَرْأَةِ وَتَحْدِيثِ المَنَاهِجِ.

questions.prompt: What is the counterfactual about investment?
options: Had investment in science returned, the region would have regained its leadership
questions.feedback: لَوْ عَادَ الاِسْتِثْمَارُ فِي العِلْمِ … لَاسْتَعَادَتِ المِنْطَقَةُ رِيَادَتَهَا.

prompts: مَاذَا كَانَ العَرَبُ قَدْ حَقَّقُوا فِي العَصْرِ الذَّهَبِيِّ؟
مَا التَّحَدِّي التَّعْلِيمِيُّ اليَوْمَ؟
لَوِ اسْتُثْمِرَ فِي التَّعْلِيمِ مُبَكِّرًا، مَاذَا كَانَ سَيَخْتَلِفُ؟
model: مَاذَا كَانَ العَرَبُ قَدْ حَقَّقُوا فِي العَصْرِ الذَّهَبِيِّ؟
كَانُوا قَدْ أَسَّسُوا دَارَ الحِكْمَةِ وَاسْتَقْطَبُوا عُلَمَاءَ مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّقَافَاتِ.
يَشْهَدُ التَّعْلِيمُ إِصْلَاحَاتٍ، لٰكِنْ لَوْ عَادَ الاِسْتِثْمَارُ كَمَا كَانَ، لَاسْتَعَادَتِ المِنْطَقَةُ رِيَادَتَهَا.

writing.prompt: Write one hundred to one hundred and ten words analysing Arab education across time. Use the past perfect for the Golden Age, the simple past and present for later periods and today, one reported-speech clause, and both conditional types.

lessons.title: Reading — Education Texts
lessons.summary: Read education texts closely: answer R1–R4, and use reported speech and conditional type as signals of a writer's source, certainty and argument.
objectives: Answer R1–R4 comprehension questions on education texts.
Read the reporting verb as a signal of certainty and stance.
Distinguish a real إِذَا argument from a hypothetical لَوْ one.
Frame an inferential R3 question about a text.
success: I locate the exact phrase that proves each answer.
I read أَكَّدَ as certain and اِدَّعَى as doubtful.
I tell whether a conditional is a real proposal or a counterfactual.
I distinguish mentioning a point from recommending it.

teach.title: The reporting verb signals certainty and stance
teach.text: أَكَّدَ الوَزِيرُ أَنَّ … signals a confident, official source; اِدَّعَى / زَعَمَ بَعْضُ المُنْتَقِدِينَ أَنَّ … signals the writer's doubt; اِعْتَرَفَ بِأَنَّ … concedes a point. Reading this layer — not just what is said, but how confidently — is a core R3 skill.

teach.title: إِذَا argues about the real; لَوْ argues about the unreal
teach.text: إِذَا زَادَ الإِنْفَاقُ، سَتَتَحَسَّنُ النَّتَائِجُ proposes a real change. لَوْ زَادَ الإِنْفَاقُ، لَتَحَسَّنَتِ النَّتَائِجُ argues from a counterfactual — implying it did not increase. Spotting which type is used tells you what argument the writer is making.

grammar.title: Reading signals: reported speech and conditional type
grammar.arabic: إِشَارَاتُ القِرَاءَةِ — الكَلَامُ المَنْقُولُ وَنَوْعُ الشَّرْطِ
grammar.overview: A reading toolkit: use the reporting verb to judge source and certainty, and the conditional type to identify the writer's argument.

rules.heading: Certainty from the reporting verb
rules.explanation: The verb reveals how the writer weighs the claim.
examples: اِدَّعَى المُنْتَقِدُونَ أَنَّ … → the writer doubts it

rules.heading: Own view vs cited view
rules.explanation: Reported speech often cites someone else, not the writer.
examples: أَشَارَ التَّقْرِيرُ إِلَى أَنَّ … → the report's view, cited

rules.heading: Conditional type as argument signal
rules.explanation: إِذَا proposes; لَوْ argues a counterfactual.
examples: إِذَا زَادَ الإِنْفَاقُ، سَتَتَحَسَّنُ النَّتَائِجُ → a proposal
لَوْ زَادَ الإِنْفَاقُ، لَتَحَسَّنَتْ → a counterfactual

rules.heading: Mention vs recommend
rules.explanation: Mentioning a point is not recommending it.

quiz.prompt: Which reporting verb signals the writer's doubt?
quiz.feedback: اِدَّعَى (claimed) signals doubt.

quiz.prompt: Which signals a confident, official source?
quiz.feedback: أَكَّدَ signals high certainty.

quiz.prompt: «أَشَارَ التَّقْرِيرُ إِلَى أَنَّ…» presents whose view?
options: The report's, cited by the writer
quiz.feedback: Reported speech cites the report, not necessarily the writer.

quiz.prompt: Which conditional is a real proposal?
options: لَوْ كَانَ الإِنْفَاقُ أَكْبَرَ، لَتَغَيَّرَ الوَضْعُ.
quiz.feedback: إِذَا … سَـ is a real proposal.

quiz.prompt: Which conditional is a counterfactual argument?
quiz.feedback: لَوْ … لَـ argues from an unreal case.

quiz.prompt: What is the difference between يَذْكُرُ and يُوصِي بِـ?
options: One is past, one is future
quiz.feedback: يَذْكُرُ mentions; يُوصِي بِـ recommends.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يَتَوَصَّلُ الكَاتِبُ ___ نَتِيجَةٍ وَاضِحَةٍ.
quiz.feedback: يَتَوَصَّلُ is fixed with إِلَى.

quiz.prompt: Which is the strongest reading of «اِعْتَرَفَ الوَزِيرُ بِأَنَّ الفَجْوَةَ قَائِمَةٌ»?
options: The minister concedes a problem he might prefer to deny
The minister is certain and proud
quiz.feedback: اِعْتَرَفَ بِـ concedes a point.

grammar.common_error: Treating all reported speech as the writer's own view, or reading a mention as a recommendation. Check the reporting verb and whether the point is proposed or merely named.
grammar.challenge: For one sentence, name the reporting verb, say what certainty it signals, and state whether any conditional is real or hypothetical.

patterns.ar: أَكَّدَ الوَزِيرُ أَنَّ الإِصْلَاحَ ضَرُورِيٌّ
patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: أَكَّدَ signals a confident, official source.

patterns.ar: اِدَّعَى بَعْضُ المُنْتَقِدِينَ أَنَّ الإِصْلَاحَ فَشِلَ
patterns.label: What to notice

patterns.ar: لَوْ زَادَ الإِنْفَاقُ، لَتَحَسَّنَتِ النَّتَائِجُ
patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: A counterfactual argument, not a proposal.

mistakes.wrong: «اِدَّعَى» تَعْنِي أَنَّ الكَاتِبَ وَاثِقٌ مِنَ الكَلَامِ.
mistakes.right: «اِدَّعَى» تُشِيرُ إِلَى شَكِّ الكَاتِبِ فِي الكَلَامِ.
mistakes.why: اِدَّعَى signals doubt, not confidence.

mistakes.wrong: ذِكْرُ الفَجْوَةِ فِي التَّقْرِيرِ يَعْنِي أَنَّهُ أَوْصَى بِسَدِّهَا.
mistakes.right: ذِكْرُ الفَجْوَةِ لَا يَعْنِي بِالضَّرُورَةِ التَّوْصِيَةَ بِسَدِّهَا.
mistakes.why: Mentioning a point is not recommending it.
يَتَوَصَّلُ is fixed with إِلَى.

listening.title: Listening: reading a report critically
listening.script: عِنْدَمَا تَقْرَأُ نَصًّا تَعْلِيمِيًّا، لَا تَنْظُرْ إِلَى مَا يُقَالُ فَقَطْ، بَلْ إِلَى كَيْفِيَّةِ قَوْلِهِ. فَحِينَ يَكْتُبُ الكَاتِبُ «أَكَّدَ الوَزِيرُ»، فَهُوَ يَنْقُلُ مَصْدَرًا رَسْمِيًّا وَاثِقًا. أَمَّا حِينَ يَكْتُبُ «اِدَّعَى بَعْضُ المُنْتَقِدِينَ»، فَهُوَ يُشِيرُ إِلَى شَكِّهِ فِي الكَلَامِ. وَالكَلَامُ المَنْقُولُ لَا يَعْنِي دَائِمًا رَأْيَ الكَاتِبِ نَفْسِهِ، بَلْ قَدْ يَنْقُلُ رَأْيَ غَيْرِهِ. وَانْتَبِهْ لِنَوْعِ الشَّرْطِ: إِذَا تُقَدِّمُ اقْتِرَاحًا وَاقِعِيًّا، وَلَوْ تُقَدِّمُ حُجَّةً افْتِرَاضِيَّةً. وَمِيِّزْ بَيْنَ ذِكْرِ فِكْرَةٍ وَالتَّوْصِيَةِ بِهَا؛ فَقَدْ يَذْكُرُ التَّقْرِيرُ فَجْوَةً دُونَ أَنْ يُوصِيَ بِحَلٍّ.

questions.prompt: What should you look at besides what is said?
questions.feedback: بَلْ إِلَى كَيْفِيَّةِ قَوْلِهِ.

questions.prompt: What does «أَكَّدَ الوَزِيرُ» convey?
questions.feedback: يَنْقُلُ مَصْدَرًا رَسْمِيًّا وَاثِقًا.

questions.prompt: What does «اِدَّعَى بَعْضُ المُنْتَقِدِينَ» signal?
options: The writer's doubt about the claim
questions.feedback: يُشِيرُ إِلَى شَكِّهِ فِي الكَلَامِ.

questions.prompt: Does reported speech always give the writer's own view?
options: No, it may report someone else's
questions.feedback: لَا يَعْنِي دَائِمًا رَأْيَ الكَاتِبِ نَفْسِهِ.

questions.prompt: What does إِذَا present, versus لَوْ?
options: إِذَا a real proposal; لَوْ a hypothetical argument
questions.feedback: إِذَا تُقَدِّمُ اقْتِرَاحًا وَاقِعِيًّا، وَلَوْ تُقَدِّمُ حُجَّةً افْتِرَاضِيَّةً.

reading.title: Reading: two education texts
reading.text: اِقْرَأِ النَّصَّيْنِ. الأَوَّلُ تَقْرِيرٌ وِزَارِيٌّ: «أَكَّدَتِ الوِزَارَةُ أَنَّ الإِصْلَاحَاتِ رَفَعَتْ نِسْبَةَ الالْتِحَاقِ، وَأَشَارَتْ إِلَى أَنَّ الفَجْوَةَ بَيْنَ المَنَاطِقِ مَا زَالَتْ قَائِمَةً. وَإِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ الاِسْتِثْمَارُ، سَتَتَقَلَّصُ الفَجْوَةُ.» وَالثَّانِي مَقَالُ رَأْيٍ: «يَدَّعِي بَعْضُ المَسْؤُولِينَ أَنَّ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَلَى مَا يُرَامُ، لٰكِنَّ الوَاقِعَ مُخْتَلِفٌ. لَوْ كَانَتِ المَدَارِسُ الرِّيفِيَّةُ مُمَوَّلَةً كَالمُدُنِ، لَاخْتَفَتِ الفَجْوَةُ مُنْذُ سَنَوَاتٍ.» النَّصُّ الأَوَّلُ مَصْدَرٌ رَسْمِيٌّ يَذْكُرُ الفَجْوَةَ وَيَقْتَرِحُ حَلًّا وَاقِعِيًّا بِـ«إِذَا». أَمَّا الثَّانِي فَيَسْتَعْمِلُ «يَدَّعِي» لِيُظْهِرَ شَكَّهُ، وَ«لَوْ» لِيُجَادِلَ بِمَا كَانَ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ يَحْدُثَ.

questions.prompt: What did the ministry stress in Text 1?
questions.feedback: أَكَّدَتِ الوِزَارَةُ أَنَّ الإِصْلَاحَاتِ رَفَعَتْ نِسْبَةَ الالْتِحَاقِ.

questions.prompt: What kind of conditional does Text 1 use?
questions.feedback: وَإِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ الاِسْتِثْمَارُ، سَتَتَقَلَّصُ الفَجْوَةُ — a real proposal.

questions.prompt: What does «يَدَّعِي» in Text 2 tell you?
options: The writer doubts the officials' claim
questions.feedback: يَسْتَعْمِلُ «يَدَّعِي» لِيُظْهِرَ شَكَّهُ.

questions.prompt: What argument does «لَوْ» make in Text 2?
options: A counterfactual: the gap could have vanished
questions.feedback: «لَوْ» لِيُجَادِلَ بِمَا كَانَ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ يَحْدُثَ.

questions.prompt: How do the two texts differ in stance?
options: Text 1 is an official source proposing; Text 2 is a sceptical opinion arguing
questions.feedback: الأَوَّلُ مَصْدَرٌ رَسْمِيٌّ … أَمَّا الثَّانِي فَيُظْهِرُ شَكَّهُ.

prompts: مَا الفِعْلُ النَّاقِلُ فِي الجُمْلَةِ؟ وَمَاذَا يَدُلُّ عَلَيْهِ؟
هَلِ الشَّرْطُ فِي النَّصِّ وَاقِعِيٌّ أَمِ افْتِرَاضِيٌّ؟
هَلْ يَذْكُرُ النَّصُّ الفِكْرَةَ أَمْ يُوصِي بِهَا؟
model: مَا الفِعْلُ النَّاقِلُ، وَمَاذَا يَدُلُّ عَلَيْهِ؟
الفِعْلُ «اِدَّعَى»، وَهُوَ يَدُلُّ عَلَى شَكِّ الكَاتِبِ فِي الكَلَامِ.
Names the verb and its signal
اِفْتِرَاضِيٌّ؛ فَـ«لَوْ … لَـ» تُجَادِلُ بِمَا كَانَ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ يَحْدُثَ، لَا بِاقْتِرَاحٍ وَاقِعِيٍّ.

writing.prompt: Write eighty to ninety words analysing a short education text of your choice. Name one reporting verb and the certainty it signals, say whether the text's conditional is real or hypothetical, and distinguish one point that is mentioned from one that is recommended.
checklist: One reporting verb identified with its certainty signal.
The conditional classified as real (إِذَا) or hypothetical (لَوْ).
A distinction between a mentioned point and a recommended one.
A statement of the writer's overall stance.
writing.model: يَكْشِفُ النَّصُّ مَوْقِفَهُ مِنْ خِلَالِ أَفْعَالِهِ النَّاقِلَةِ. فَحِينَ يَكْتُبُ «أَكَّدَتِ الوِزَارَةُ»، فَهُوَ يَنْقُلُ مَصْدَرًا رَسْمِيًّا وَاثِقًا، أَمَّا «يَدَّعِي المُنْتَقِدُونَ» فَتُظْهِرُ شَكَّهُ. وَالشَّرْطُ فِي النَّصِّ الأَوَّلِ وَاقِعِيٌّ؛ فَـ«إِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ الاِسْتِثْمَارُ، سَتَتَقَلَّصُ الفَجْوَةُ» اقْتِرَاحٌ حَقِيقِيٌّ. أَمَّا فِي النَّصِّ الثَّانِي فَـ«لَوْ» تُقَدِّمُ حُجَّةً افْتِرَاضِيَّةً. وَأُمَيِّزُ بَيْنَ ذِكْرِ الفَجْوَةِ وَالتَّوْصِيَةِ بِسَدِّهَا؛ فَالتَّقْرِيرُ يَذْكُرُهَا وَيَقْتَرِحُ حَلًّا، بَيْنَمَا يَكْتَفِي المَقَالُ بِالنَّقْدِ. لِذٰلِكَ أَقْرَأُ النَّصَّيْنِ بِوَعْيٍ بِمَصْدَرِهِمَا وَمَوْقِفِهِمَا.

differentiation.core: Classify six reporting verbs as certain, doubtful or neutral.
differentiation.develop: For two sentences, say whether the conditional is real or hypothetical.
differentiation.stretch: Write an R3-style question requiring analysis of a conditional or reporting verb.

final.feedback: اِدَّعَى signals the writer's doubt.

final.prompt: Which conditional is a real proposal?
options: لَوْ كَانَتِ المَدَارِسُ مُمَوَّلَةً، لَاخْتَفَتِ الفَجْوَةُ.
final.feedback: إِذَا … سَـ is a real proposal.
يَتَوَصَّلُ is fixed with إِلَى.

options: «اِدَّعَى» تُظْهِرُ شَكَّ الكَاتِبِ، وَ«لَوْ» تُقَدِّمُ حُجَّةً افْتِرَاضِيَّةً لَا اقْتِرَاحًا.
final.feedback: It reads the doubtful verb and the counterfactual accurately.

mission.title: Critical Reading Mission — Verb, Certainty and Conditional
mission.intro: Judge the reporting verb's certainty, classify the conditional, and separate mention from recommendation.

rounds.feedback: اِدَّعَى signals doubt.
أَكَّدَ signals high certainty.
اِعْتَرَفَ بِـ concedes a point.
إِذَا … سَـ proposes a real change.
لَوْ … لَـ argues from an unreal case.
Reported speech frequently cites another source.
Mentioning a point is not recommending it.
يَتَوَصَّلُ takes إِلَى.
يَسْتَشْهِدُ takes بِـ.
حُجَّةٌ مُضَادَّةٌ is a counter-argument.

rounds.prompt: Reading: «اِعْتَرَفَ الوَزِيرُ بِأَنَّ الفَجْوَةَ قَائِمَةٌ» means …
rounds.feedback: اِعْتَرَفَ بِـ concedes a point.
زَعَمَ signals doubt.

rounds.prompt: Skill: the best R3 question requires …
options: analysis with evidence, not one-word finding
rounds.feedback: R3 questions require explanation, not mere identification.

rounds.prompt: Transfer: which is the most complete critical reading?
options: الفِعْلُ «يَدَّعِي» يُظْهِرُ شَكَّ الكَاتِبِ، وَ«لَوْ» تُقَدِّمُ حُجَّةً افْتِرَاضِيَّةً، وَالتَّقْرِيرُ يَذْكُرُ الفَجْوَةَ دُونَ أَنْ يُوصِيَ بِحَلٍّ.
rounds.feedback: It reads the doubtful verb, the counterfactual and the mention-vs-recommend distinction.

live_builder.target: Build a text analysis from a reporting-verb reading, a conditional-type reading and a stance judgement.
groups: الفِعْلُ «أَكَّدَ» يَنْقُلُ مَصْدَرًا رَسْمِيًّا وَاثِقًا
الفِعْلُ «اِدَّعَى» يُظْهِرُ شَكَّ الكَاتِبِ
الفِعْلُ «اِعْتَرَفَ بِـ» يَكْشِفُ تَنَازُلًا
وَالشَّرْطُ بِـ«إِذَا» اقْتِرَاحٌ وَاقِعِيٌّ لِلْمُسْتَقْبَلِ
وَالشَّرْطُ بِـ«لَوْ» حُجَّةٌ افْتِرَاضِيَّةٌ عَنِ المَاضِي
وَنَوْعُ الشَّرْطِ يَكْشِفُ حُجَّةَ الكَاتِبِ
وَالنَّصُّ يَذْكُرُ الفِكْرَةَ دُونَ أَنْ يُوصِيَ بِهَا
وَالكَلَامُ المَنْقُولُ يَنْقُلُ رَأْيَ غَيْرِهِ لَا رَأْيَهُ
لِذٰلِكَ أَقْرَأُ النَّصَّ بِوَعْيٍ بِمَصْدَرِهِ وَمَوْقِفِهِ
live_builder.feedback: Each reporting-verb reading, conditional reading and stance judgement is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations work.

builder_tasks.title: Correct the certainty reading
builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the claim about what اِدَّعَى signals.
builder_tasks.feedback: اِدَّعَى signals doubt, not confidence.

builder_tasks.title: Separate mention from recommendation
builder_tasks.instruction: Correct the inference about mentioning a point.
options: ذِكْرُ الفَجْوَةِ لَا يَعْنِي بِالضَّرُورَةِ التَّوْصِيَةَ بِسَدِّهَا.
ذِكْرُ الفَجْوَةِ هُوَ نَفْسُهُ التَّوْصِيَةُ بِسَدِّهَا.
builder_tasks.feedback: Mentioning a point is not recommending it.

builder_tasks.title: Real or hypothetical argument?
builder_tasks.instruction: Pick the reading that matches each conditional to the writer's argument.
builder_tasks.context: Text A writes «إِذَا اسْتَمَرَّ الاِسْتِثْمَارُ، سَتَتَقَلَّصُ الفَجْوَةُ». Text B writes «لَوْ كَانَتِ المَدَارِسُ مُمَوَّلَةً، لَاخْتَفَتِ الفَجْوَةُ». Match each conditional to the argument it makes.
options: النَّصُّ الأَوَّلُ يَقْتَرِحُ حَلًّا وَاقِعِيًّا بِـ«إِذَا»، وَالثَّانِي يُجَادِلُ بِحُجَّةٍ افْتِرَاضِيَّةٍ بِـ«لَوْ».
builder_tasks.feedback: إِذَا … سَـ proposes a real change; لَوْ … لَـ argues a counterfactual.

lessons.title: Writing — Education and Future Plans (Paper 4 Extended Writing)
lessons.summary: Integrate all five P2 structures — past perfect, reported speech, both conditional types and the future — into a 140-155 word Paper 4 Q3 article.
objectives: Plan a four-paragraph education article carrying every P2 structure.
Combine past perfect, reported speech and both conditional types in one text.
Raise register with formal connectors and academic vocabulary.
Self-assess against the nine P2 Range criteria.
success: I place كَانَ قَدْ in the background and reported speech in the current reality.
I include both a Type 1 (إِذَا) and a Type 2 (لَوْ) conditional.
I join ideas with formal connectors, not only وَ.
I pack more than one structure into my strongest sentence.

teach.title: One sentence can carry three structures
teach.text: كَانَ مُرْشِدِي قَدْ أَشَارَ إِلَى أَنَّنِي سَأَنْجَحُ، وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَتِ المَوَارِدُ، لَتَفَوَّقْتُ أَكْثَرَ combines a past perfect, reported speech and a Type 2 conditional. That density of range is what a top Paper 4 answer looks like.

teach.title: Map a structure to each paragraph
teach.text: P1 background with كَانَ قَدْ; P2 current reality in the present with reported speech; P3 analysis with a Type 1 and a Type 2 conditional; P4 a forward look with the future and a formal connector. The plan is what turns five structures into a coherent article.

grammar.title: Assembling the full P2 range
grammar.arabic: تَرْكِيبُ النِّطَاقِ الكَامِلِ فِي السَّنَةِ العَاشِرَةِ
grammar.overview: A synthesis rather than a new rule: how to place and combine the five P2 structures and lift register with connectors.

rules.heading: Background with past perfect
rules.explanation: Open with what had already happened.
examples: كُنْتُ قَدْ قَرَّرْتُ تَخَصُّصِي قَبْلَ الثَّانَوِيَّةِ

rules.heading: Reality with reported speech
rules.explanation: Cite a teacher or study in the present reality.

rules.heading: Both conditionals in analysis
rules.explanation: A real proposal and a counterfactual side by side.

rules.heading: Lift register with connectors
rules.explanation: Replace bare وَ with a formal connector.
examples: عَلَاوَةً عَلَى ذٰلِكَ، أَطْمَحُ إِلَى البَحْثِ العِلْمِيِّ

quiz.prompt: Which sentence carries the most P2 structures?
options: كَانَ مُرْشِدِي قَدْ أَشَارَ إِلَى أَنَّنِي سَأَنْجَحُ، وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَتِ المَوَارِدُ، لَتَفَوَّقْتُ.
quiz.feedback: It combines a past perfect, reported speech and a Type 2 conditional.

quiz.prompt: Which structure belongs in the background paragraph?
quiz.feedback: The past perfect opens the background.

quiz.prompt: Which pair shows both conditional types?
options: إِذَا قُبِلْتُ سَأَدْرُسُ؛ وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ لَتَفَوَّقْتُ.
إِذَا قُبِلْتُ سَأَدْرُسُ؛ وَإِذَا تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ سَأَتَفَوَّقُ.
لَوْ قُبِلْتُ لَدَرَسْتُ؛ وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ لَتَفَوَّقْتُ.
quiz.feedback: One Type 1 (إِذَا … سَـ) and one Type 2 (لَوْ … لَـ).

quiz.prompt: Which is a formal connector rather than a plain link?
quiz.feedback: عَلَاوَةً عَلَى ذٰلِكَ raises the register.

quiz.prompt: Which reports a teacher accurately?
quiz.feedback: أَشَارَ إِلَى أَنَّ is the correct structure.

quiz.prompt: Complete the past-perfect background: ___ قَدْ قَرَّرْتُ تَخَصُّصِي.
quiz.feedback: كُنْتُ is the first-person past-perfect form.

quiz.prompt: Which closes an article at academic register?
quiz.feedback: وَخِتَامًا opens a formal conclusion.

quiz.prompt: Which shows the writer distinguishing real from hypothetical?
options: إِذَا اجْتَهَدْتُ سَأَنْجَحُ، لٰكِنْ لَوْ بَدَأْتُ مُبَكِّرًا لَكُنْتُ أَفْضَلَ.
إِذَا اجْتَهَدْتُ سَأَنْجَحُ وَإِذَا بَدَأْتُ مُبَكِّرًا سَأَكُونُ أَفْضَلَ.
quiz.feedback: It uses إِذَا for the real and لَوْ for the counterfactual.

grammar.common_error: Writing 150 fluent words with only one structure, or using two Type 1 conditionals instead of one of each type. Range rewards variety and the real/hypothetical contrast.
grammar.challenge: Draft one sentence that combines a past perfect, reported speech and a Type 2 conditional.

patterns.ar: كُنْتُ قَدْ قَرَّرْتُ تَخَصُّصِي قَبْلَ الثَّانَوِيَّةِ
patterns.label: What to notice

patterns.ar: إِذَا قُبِلْتُ سَأُكَرِّسُ جُهْدِي، وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَتِ المَوَارِدُ لَتَفَوَّقْتُ
patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: Type 1 and Type 2 side by side.

patterns.ar: عَلَاوَةً عَلَى ذٰلِكَ، أَشَارَ مُرْشِدِي إِلَى أَنَّنِي مُؤَهَّلٌ
patterns.label: What to notice

mistakes.wrong: إِذَا قُبِلْتُ سَأَدْرُسُ؛ وَإِذَا تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ سَأَتَفَوَّقُ.
mistakes.right: إِذَا قُبِلْتُ سَأَدْرُسُ؛ وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ لَتَفَوَّقْتُ.
mistakes.why: Range rewards one of each type: keep a Type 2 (لَوْ … لَـ) as well.
قَالَ takes إِنَّ, not أَنَّ.
كَانَ must agree with the first-person subject: كُنْتُ.

items.label: بِحُلُولِ الثَّانَوِيَّةِ كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْجَزْتُ مَشْرُوعًا
عَلَاوَةً عَلَى ذٰلِكَ، سَوْفَ أُسْهِمُ فِي مَجَالِي
بِنَاءً عَلَى مَا سَبَقَ، التَّعْلِيمُ اسْتِثْمَارٌ

listening.title: Listening: an examiner on P2 range
listening.script: فِي الوَرَقَةِ الرَّابِعَةِ، يُقَيِّمُ المُصَحِّحُ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْيَاءَ: المُحْتَوَى، وَالنِّطَاقَ، وَالدِّقَّةَ. وَفِي السَّنَةِ العَاشِرَةِ، النِّطَاقُ يَعْنِي دَمْجَ خَمْسِ بُنًى: المَاضِي التَّامِّ، وَالكَلَامِ المَنْقُولِ، وَالشَّرْطِ بِنَوْعَيْهِ، وَالمُسْتَقْبَلِ. النَّصُّ الَّذِي يَحْمِلُ «إِذَا» وَ«لَوْ» مَعًا يُظْهِرُ أَنَّ الكَاتِبَ يُمَيِّزُ بَيْنَ المُمْكِنِ وَالافْتِرَاضِيِّ. اِفْتَحْ بِخَلْفِيَّةٍ فِي المَاضِي التَّامِّ، ثُمَّ اعْرِضِ الوَاقِعَ الحَالِيَّ بِالكَلَامِ المَنْقُولِ، ثُمَّ حَلِّلْ بِالشَّرْطَيْنِ، وَاخْتِمْ بِالمُسْتَقْبَلِ وَرَابِطٍ رَسْمِيٍّ. اُكْتُبْ مِئَةً وَأَرْبَعِينَ إِلَى مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسِينَ كَلِمَةً.

questions.prompt: What three things does Paper 4 Q3 assess?
questions.feedback: يُقَيِّمُ … المُحْتَوَى، وَالنِّطَاقَ، وَالدِّقَّةَ.

questions.prompt: What does range mean at P2 level?
questions.feedback: النِّطَاقُ يَعْنِي دَمْجَ خَمْسِ بُنًى.

questions.prompt: What does a text with both إِذَا and لَوْ show?
options: The writer distinguishes possible from hypothetical
questions.feedback: يُظْهِرُ أَنَّ الكَاتِبَ يُمَيِّزُ بَيْنَ المُمْكِنِ وَالافْتِرَاضِيِّ.

questions.prompt: How should the article open?
questions.feedback: اِفْتَحْ بِخَلْفِيَّةٍ فِي المَاضِي التَّامِّ.

questions.prompt: Where does the analysis with both conditionals go?
options: In the third move, before the conclusion
questions.feedback: ثُمَّ حَلِّلْ بِالشَّرْطَيْنِ، وَاخْتِمْ بِالمُسْتَقْبَلِ.

reading.title: Reading: an annotated model (extract)
reading.text: كُنْتُ قَدْ قَرَّرْتُ دِرَاسَةَ الطِّبِّ مُنْذُ المَرْحَلَةِ الإِعْدَادِيَّةِ، وَبِحُلُولِ الثَّانَوِيَّةِ كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْجَزْتُ مَشْرُوعًا بَحْثِيًّا. أَدْرُسُ الآنَ فِي السَّنَةِ الأَخِيرَةِ، وَقَدْ أَشَارَ أُسْتَاذِي إِلَى أَنَّنِي مُؤَهَّلٌ لِلْمُنَافَسَةِ، وَأَكَّدَ أَنَّ اجْتِهَادِي سَيُثْمِرُ. إِذَا قُبِلْتُ فِي كُلِّيَّةِ الطِّبِّ، سَأُكَرِّسُ جُهْدِي لِلْبَحْثِ. عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ، لَوْ تَوَافَرَتْ لِي مَوَارِدُ أَفْضَلُ مُبَكِّرًا، لَكُنْتُ قَدْ تَقَدَّمْتُ أَكْثَرَ. عَلَاوَةً عَلَى ذٰلِكَ، أَرَى أَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ أَقْوَى أَدَاةٍ لِلتَّغْيِيرِ. وَخِتَامًا، سَوْفَ أَسْعَى إِلَى خِدْمَةِ مُجْتَمَعِي.

questions.prompt: Which structure opens the text?
questions.feedback: كُنْتُ قَدْ قَرَّرْتُ … is the past perfect.

questions.prompt: How is the teacher's view presented?
questions.feedback: أَشَارَ أُسْتَاذِي إِلَى أَنَّنِي مُؤَهَّلٌ.

questions.prompt: Which is the Type 1 conditional?
questions.feedback: إِذَا … سَـ is the Type 1 conditional.

questions.prompt: Which is the Type 2 conditional?
options: لَوْ تَوَافَرَتْ لِي مَوَارِدُ أَفْضَلُ، لَكُنْتُ قَدْ تَقَدَّمْتُ
questions.feedback: لَوْ … لَـ is the Type 2 conditional.

questions.prompt: How does the text close?
options: With the future and a formal connector
questions.feedback: وَخِتَامًا، سَوْفَ أَسْعَى إِلَى خِدْمَةِ مُجْتَمَعِي.

prompts: مَا خَلْفِيَّتُكَ فِي المَاضِي التَّامِّ؟
مَاذَا قَالَ مُعَلِّمُوكَ عَنْكَ؟
مَا جُمْلَتُكَ الشَّرْطِيَّةُ مِنَ النَّوْعِ الثَّانِي؟
model: كُنْتُ قَدْ قَرَّرْتُ مَجَالِي مُبَكِّرًا، وَكُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْجَزْتُ مَشْرُوعًا بَحْثِيًّا.
لَوْ تَوَافَرَتْ لِي مَوَارِدُ أَفْضَلُ، لَتَفَوَّقْتُ أَكْثَرَ، لٰكِنْ إِذَا اجْتَهَدْتُ، سَأُحَقِّقُ طُمُوحِي.
Type 2 counterfactual plus a Type 1 proposal

writing.prompt: Write a 140-155 word article on education and future plans. Include all five P2 structures: a past-perfect background, reported speech, a Type 1 conditional, a Type 2 conditional and the future, joined with at least two formal connectors.
checklist: A past-perfect background sentence (كُنْتُ قَدْ …).
One reported-speech clause with a verb other than قَالَ.
One Type 1 (إِذَا … سَـ) and one Type 2 (لَوْ … لَـ) conditional.
Two formal connectors and a future conclusion; 140-155 words.
writing.model: كُنْتُ قَدْ قَرَّرْتُ دِرَاسَةَ الطِّبِّ مُنْذُ المَرْحَلَةِ الإِعْدَادِيَّةِ، وَبِحُلُولِ الثَّانَوِيَّةِ كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْجَزْتُ مَشْرُوعًا بَحْثِيًّا وَحَصَلْتُ عَلَى خِبْرَةٍ فِي مُسْتَشْفًى. أَدْرُسُ الآنَ فِي السَّنَةِ الأَخِيرَةِ، وَقَدْ أَشَارَ أُسْتَاذِي إِلَى أَنَّنِي مُؤَهَّلٌ لِلْمُنَافَسَةِ، وَأَكَّدَ أَنَّ اجْتِهَادِي سَيُثْمِرُ. إِذَا قُبِلْتُ فِي كُلِّيَّةِ الطِّبِّ، سَأُكَرِّسُ جُهْدِي لِلْبَحْثِ العِلْمِيِّ. عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ، لَوْ تَوَافَرَتْ لِي مَوَارِدُ أَفْضَلُ مُبَكِّرًا، لَكُنْتُ قَدْ تَقَدَّمْتُ أَكْثَرَ. عَلَاوَةً عَلَى ذٰلِكَ، أَرَى أَنَّ التَّعْلِيمَ الجَيِّدَ أَقْوَى مِنَ المَالِ فِي تَغْيِيرِ حَيَاةِ الفَرْدِ. وَخِتَامًا، سَوْفَ أَسْعَى إِلَى خِدْمَةِ مُجْتَمَعِي، فَالتَّعْلِيمُ اسْتِثْمَارٌ فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ.

differentiation.core: Write the four-paragraph plan with one sentence per structure.
differentiation.develop: Expand to 140 words with five structures labelled.
differentiation.stretch: Reach 155 words with two connectors and one sentence combining three structures.

final.prompt: Which sentence shows the widest P2 range?
options: كَانَ مُرْشِدِي قَدْ أَشَارَ إِلَى أَنَّنِي سَأَنْجَحُ، وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَتِ المَوَارِدُ، لَتَفَوَّقْتُ.
final.feedback: It combines a past perfect, reported speech and a Type 2 conditional.

final.prompt: Which pair correctly shows both conditional types?
options: إِذَا قُبِلْتُ سَأَدْرُسُ؛ وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ لَتَفَوَّقْتُ.
إِذَا قُبِلْتُ سَأَدْرُسُ؛ وَإِذَا تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ سَأَتَفَوَّقُ.
لَوْ قُبِلْتُ لَدَرَسْتُ؛ وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ لَتَفَوَّقْتُ.
final.feedback: One Type 1 and one Type 2.
أَشَارَ إِلَى أَنَّ is correct.
كَانَ must agree with the first-person subject: كُنْتُ.

mission.title: Range Mission — Integrate the Five Structures
mission.intro: Place each structure in the right paragraph and pack more than one into a single sentence.

rounds.prompt: Structure: which belongs in the background?
rounds.feedback: The past perfect opens the background.

rounds.prompt: Report: complete — أَشَارَ أُسْتَاذِي ___ أَنَّنِي مُؤَهَّلٌ.
rounds.feedback: أَشَارَ takes إِلَى before أَنَّ.

rounds.prompt: Report: complete — قَالَ مُرْشِدِي ___ المَجَالَ وَاعِدٌ.
rounds.feedback: قَالَ takes إِنَّ.
A Type 1 result takes سَـ.
A Type 2 result takes لَـ on a past verb.
كُنْتُ is the first-person past-perfect form.
عَلَاوَةً عَلَى ذٰلِكَ is a formal connector.

rounds.prompt: Density: which sentence carries three structures?
options: كَانَ قَدْ أَشَارَ إِلَى أَنَّنِي سَأَنْجَحُ، وَلَوْ اجْتَهَدْتُ أَكْثَرَ لَتَفَوَّقْتُ.
rounds.feedback: Past perfect + reported speech + Type 2 conditional.

rounds.prompt: Contrast: which distinguishes real from hypothetical?
options: إِذَا اجْتَهَدْتُ سَأَنْجَحُ، لٰكِنْ لَوْ بَدَأْتُ مُبَكِّرًا لَكُنْتُ أَفْضَلَ.
إِذَا اجْتَهَدْتُ سَأَنْجَحُ وَإِذَا بَدَأْتُ مُبَكِّرًا سَأَكُونُ أَفْضَلَ.
rounds.feedback: إِذَا for the real, لَوْ for the counterfactual.

rounds.prompt: Conclusion: which opens a formal close?
options: وَخِتَامًا، سَوْفَ أَسْعَى إِلَى مُوَاكَبَةِ التَّغْيِيرِ.
rounds.feedback: وَخِتَامًا opens a formal conclusion.
التَّكَامُلُ النَّحْوِيُّ is grammatical integration.

rounds.prompt: Object: which sentence uses يَدْمُجُ accurately?
rounds.feedback: يَدْمُجُ takes a direct object.

rounds.prompt: Range: which is the strongest single sentence?
options: كُنْتُ قَدْ أَنْجَزْتُ مَشْرُوعًا، وَأَشَارَ أُسْتَاذِي إِلَى أَنَّنِي مُؤَهَّلٌ، وَلَوْ بَدَأْتُ مُبَكِّرًا لَتَقَدَّمْتُ.
أَنْجَزْتُ مَشْرُوعًا وَأُسْتَاذِي قَالَ إِنِّي مُؤَهَّلٌ.
rounds.feedback: It integrates a past perfect, reported speech and a Type 2 conditional.

rounds.prompt: Transfer: which article line is the most complete?
options: إِذَا قُبِلْتُ سَأُكَرِّسُ جُهْدِي، وَعَلَاوَةً عَلَى ذٰلِكَ، لَوْ تَوَافَرَتِ المَوَارِدُ لَتَفَوَّقْتُ أَكْثَرَ.
التَّعْلِيمُ مُهِمٌّ وَالمُسْتَقْبَلُ مُهِمٌّ وَأَنَا مُجْتَهِدٌ.
rounds.feedback: A Type 1, a formal connector and a Type 2 in one line.

live_builder.feedback: Each background, analysis and conclusion clause is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations work.

builder_tasks.title: Fix the past-perfect agreement
builder_tasks.instruction: Make كَانَ agree with the first-person subject.
builder_tasks.feedback: كَانَ must agree with the first-person subject: كُنْتُ.

builder_tasks.title: Add the second conditional type
builder_tasks.instruction: Rewrite the second clause as a Type 2 conditional for range.
builder_tasks.source: إِذَا قُبِلْتُ سَأَدْرُسُ؛ وَإِذَا تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ سَأَتَفَوَّقُ.
options: إِذَا قُبِلْتُ سَأَدْرُسُ؛ وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ لَتَفَوَّقْتُ.
إِذَا قُبِلْتُ سَأَدْرُسُ؛ وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ سَأَتَفَوَّقُ.
لَوْ قُبِلْتُ لَدَرَسْتُ؛ وَلَوْ تَوَافَرَ الدَّعْمُ لَتَفَوَّقْتُ.
builder_tasks.feedback: Range rewards one Type 1 and one Type 2 (لَوْ … لَـ).

builder_tasks.title: Raise the register
builder_tasks.instruction: Replace the chained وَ with a formal connector.
options: عَلَاوَةً عَلَى ذٰلِكَ، يُمَثِّلُ التَّعْلِيمُ اسْتِثْمَارًا فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ.
builder_tasks.feedback: A formal connector and an analytical verb add range.

lessons.title: Listening — Education and Future Plans Texts
lessons.summary: Complete Paper 1 style education listening: catch the reporting verb and its content, tell إِذَا from لَوْ by ear, and hear كَانَ قَدْ as one fast unit.
objectives: Predict which structure each question targets before listening.
Catch the reporting verb, إِنَّ/أَنَّ and the reported content.
Distinguish a real إِذَا conditional from a hypothetical لَوْ one aurally.
Hear the fast past-perfect unit كَانَ قَدْ.
success: I annotate each question with its target structure.
I identify who is speaking from the reporting verb and pronoun.
I know لَوْ + past means the speaker is describing a counterfactual.
I catch all three parts of كَانَ قَدْ + verb.

teach.title: Reported speech has three audible parts
teach.text: «قَالَ مُرْشِدِي إِنَّنِي سَأَنْجَحُ» — catch the reporting verb (قَالَ = who), the particle plus pronoun (إِنَّنِي = what is reported, and about whom), and the content (سَأَنْجَحُ = future kept). Missing any part loses the meaning.

teach.title: إِذَا is real; لَوْ signals a counterfactual
teach.text: If you hear إِذَا + a verb and then سَـ, the speaker means a real, possible plan. If you hear لَوْ + a past verb, they are imagining an unreal case. That single word changes what the answer means.

grammar.title: Hearing P2 structures in fast speech
grammar.arabic: سَمَاعُ بُنَى السَّنَةِ العَاشِرَةِ فِي الكَلَامِ السَّرِيعِ
grammar.overview: A listening toolkit: decode reported speech, distinguish conditional types by their signal words, and catch the fast past-perfect unit.

rules.heading: Decode reported speech
rules.explanation: The verb tells you the source; the pronoun tells you about whom.
examples: أَشَارَ الخَبِيرُ إِلَى أَنَّ الإِصْلَاحَ ضَرُورِيٌّ

rules.heading: إِذَا vs لَوْ by ear
rules.explanation: The signal word fixes the meaning of the answer.

rules.heading: Catch the past-perfect unit
rules.explanation: Spoken fast as one unit; hear all three parts.

rules.heading: Own view vs cited view
rules.explanation: A reporting verb signals a cited view, not the speaker's own.
examples: أَرَى أَنَّ … (own) vs قَالَ الخَبِيرُ إِنَّ … (cited)

quiz.prompt: In «قَالَ مُرْشِدِي إِنَّنِي سَأَنْجَحُ», who is described as succeeding?
quiz.feedback: إِنَّنِي refers to the speaker; the mentor is the source.

quiz.prompt: You hear إِذَا followed by a verb and سَـ. This is …
quiz.feedback: إِذَا … سَـ is a real conditional.

quiz.prompt: You hear لَوْ followed by a past verb. This signals …
quiz.feedback: لَوْ + past signals a hypothetical, counterfactual case.

quiz.prompt: Which is the past-perfect marker to listen for?
quiz.feedback: كَانَ قَدْ marks the past perfect.

quiz.prompt: Which tells you a claim is cited, not the speaker's own?
options: a reporting verb like قَالَ / أَشَارَ
quiz.feedback: A reporting verb signals a cited source.

quiz.prompt: Complete: أَشَارَ الخَبِيرُ ___ أَنَّ الإِصْلَاحَ ضَرُورِيٌّ.
quiz.feedback: أَشَارَ takes إِلَى before أَنَّ.

quiz.prompt: Which pronoun change fits reporting a boy's «سَأَدْرُسُ»?
quiz.feedback: Third-person masculine: إِنَّهُ سَيَدْرُسُ.

quiz.prompt: Why does إِذَا vs لَوْ matter for the answer?
options: It changes whether the plan is real or hypothetical
It changes the tense of every verb
quiz.feedback: The signal word fixes whether the situation is real or counterfactual.

grammar.common_error: Treating a reported view as the speaker's own, or hearing لَوْ as a real plan. The reporting verb marks a source, and لَوْ marks a counterfactual.
grammar.challenge: For three prepared questions, write the exact signal word you will listen for.

patterns.label: What to notice

patterns.label: What to notice
